zadruge.opis_stranice: See how many people from your place are already in the Kolo and how many are still needed for the first cooperative.
zadruge.meta_opis: Cooperatives in the KOLO system by place: how many participants there are in each place and which cooperatives are registered in the system.
zadruge.pravilnik_napomena: Entry of a cooperative in the system, cooperative members and the cooperative's records are governed by the
zadruge.detalj_opis: Cooperative in {lokalitet}. It receives goods and issues them to its members and to other cooperatives. The number of POEN is set by the cooperative.
zadruge.prestala: This cooperative's participation in the system has ended; its record is closed.
zadruge.zapis_se_otvara: The record opens with {n} cooperative members.
zadruge.nema_zadrugara: The cooperative has no linked cooperative members yet.
zadruge.samo_redovni: Cooperative members and the cooperative's records are visible to participants.
zadruge.prepis_opis: For goods the cooperative issued to you, for use of equipment or for a cooperative service. The number of POEN is set by the cooperative.
zadruge.osnov_OPREMA: Use of equipment, machinery or land
zadruge.prepis_opis_polje: What you received (e.g. 5 kg of potatoes)
zadruge.napomena_pravno: A cooperative is an independent legal entity managed by its members. It has a cooperation agreement with the Foundation, and the Foundation has neither a vote nor a share in it.
zadruge.zajednica_korak_1: Gather people from your place: at a meeting everyone can open an account in a couple of minutes.
zadruge.zajednica_korak_2: One Kolo member who knows you personally is enough: they confirm those they know, and those confirmed go on to confirm their acquaintances. If there is no such person yet, one of you chooses “I'd like someone to call me” and, after the conversation, joins the Kolo and then introduces the others.
zadruge.zajednica_korak_3: Once the place has {prag} participants, you found the first cooperative with the Foundation's help.
zadruge.zajednica_napomena: Invite the Foundation to come and explain: kontakt@ekolo.rs. An association can also be a sponsor, with money or with goods and services.

firme.nema_firmi: No company currently has free vouchers.

gazdinstva.meta_opis: Local farms in the KOLO system and farm registration.
gazdinstva.uvod: Farms feed their area, and they are why people come to the Marketplace. If you have a garden, an orchard, chickens or beehives, or make home-made food, register a farm. Entry in the Register of Agricultural Holdings is not required.
gazdinstva.gost_korak_1: You open an account and register the farm.
gazdinstva.gost_korak_2: You post at least {min} listings of food or agricultural products on behalf of the farm, for example: eggs, milk, cheese, preserves, seedlings.
gazdinstva.gost_korak_3: The Foundation talks with the holder and decides on the registration. An approved farm gets a point on the map, and its listings the DOMAĆE label.
gazdinstva.poziv_kartica: You have been invited to join the farm “{naziv}” ({naselje}). Open it to accept or decline.
gazdinstva.prijavi_poziv: Once the farm is approved, a contribution is noted for its members. It is recorded once the member has a listing offering something and is in the Kolo.
gazdinstva.mapa_napomena: The address is shown on the map with the statement given in the registration. You contact the farm through its listings on the Marketplace.
gazdinstva.pogledaj_mapu: View the map of farms and sponsors →
gazdinstva.doniraj_u_ime: Donate on behalf of the farm (money, goods or services) →
gazdinstva.nema_gazdinstava: There are no approved farms yet.
gazdinstva.oglasa_n: {n, plural, =0 {no active listings} one {# listing} other {# listings}}
gazdinstva.pravilnik_napomena: Registration, members, listings and the map are governed by the
gazdinstva.privatnost_napomena: How name and surname, address and the point on the map are processed is set out in the
gazdinstva.vraceno_razlog: The registration was returned for supplementing: {razlog}
gazdinstva.nema_oglasa: The farm currently has no active listings.
gazdinstva.domace_napomena: Listings on behalf of a farm carry the DOMAĆE label. The Foundation does not check or guarantee the origin, quality or safety of what is offered. For that, as for food and trade regulations, the person posting the listing is responsible.
gazdinstva.poziv_tekst: By joining you declare that the farm details are accurate and that you work on it. If the farm is already approved, the Foundation reviews your joining.
gazdinstva.poziv_uslov_kolo: Joining is approved once you are a Kolo member. A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you: show them your code on the Confirmation page.
gazdinstva.upit_naslov: Take over the statement on the accuracy of the data
gazdinstva.upit_tekst: The member who was responsible for the statement on the accuracy of the farm's data no longer gives it. You can take it over until {rok}. If no member takes it over, the farm terminates, and the members' noted farm contribution is cancelled and the recorded one written off.
gazdinstva.upit_odbij: I do not take it over
gazdinstva.upit_odbij_potvrda: Decline? The request goes to the next member in order of joining.
gazdinstva.upit_preuzeto: You now give the statement on the accuracy of the data.
gazdinstva.bez_prava_upravljanja: The farm is managed by those farm members who are Kolo members.
gazdinstva.pozovi_bez_clanova: The farm accepts members once it was registered by a Kolo member, or once the applicant is confirmed by a Kolo member who knows them personally.
gazdinstva.pozovi_samo_kolo: Members are invited to the farm by a farm member who is a Kolo member.
gazdinstva.izlazak_poslednji: You are the last member: the farm thereby terminates. Your noted farm contribution of {ponisten} POEN will be cancelled and {otpis} POEN written off; the record may become negative. The contribution for the first listing remains.
gazdinstva.istupi_upit: Responsibility for the statement on the accuracy of the data then passes to the member who takes it over; the other members receive the request in order of joining.
gazdinstva.obrisi_ima_clanove: The farm has other members, so it is not deleted: your request has the effect of leaving, and the other members, in order of joining, receive a request to take over the statement on the accuracy of the data. Continue?
gazdinstva.uloga_clan_opis: Farm member (an adult who works on the farm permanently or occasionally)
gazdinstva.izjava: I declare that the farm details are accurate, that the farm exists and produces what is stated, and that I work on it. I myself answer for what I offer, under the regulations that apply to it. I am aware that if the declaration is not accurate, the approval is cancelled, the farm contribution is written off, and whoever gave the false declaration or knew of it is excluded from the system.
gazdinstva.pristupanje_na_pregledu: Your joining is awaiting review by the Foundation.
gazdinstva.prijava_na_pregledu: The registration is under review by the Foundation.
gazdinstva.oglasi_uz_prijavu: Listings on behalf of the farm: {n} of at least {min}. The listings offer food or agricultural products. Once there are enough, the registration can go to review.
gazdinstva.postavi_oglas: Post a listing on behalf of the farm
gazdinstva.poslato_na_pregled: The registration has been submitted to the Foundation for review.
gazdinstva.pozovi_opis: A user who works on the farm permanently or occasionally and has an adult account on the platform. Enter their pseudonym.
gazdinstva.preuzmi_upravljanje: Take over the statement on the accuracy of the data (holder)
gazdinstva.upravljanje_preuzeto: You are now responsible for the statement on the accuracy of the data.
gazdinstva.istupi_potvrda: Leave the farm? The POEN in your record stays yours.
gazdinstva.prijava_uvod: Registration is free. After it you post at least {min} listings of food or agricultural products on behalf of the farm and send the registration to the Foundation. Before approval the Foundation talks with the holder by phone.
gazdinstva.prijava_samo_rpg: Until you are a Kolo member, you register the farm as its holder, without other members. It accepts members once you become a Kolo member. If you are not yet in the Kolo, the Foundation also offers you the “I'd like someone to call me” list with the registration.
gazdinstva.polje_neregistrovano: The farm is not entered in the Register of Agricultural Holdings
gazdinstva.polje_bpg_napomena: If the farm is in the Register of Agricultural Holdings, enter its registration number (BPG). It is not shown to other users, and the Foundation does not check it in the register.
gazdinstva.polje_opis_primer: vegetables, fruit, milk and dairy products, meat, eggs, honey, grains, preserves…
gazdinstva.polje_lokacija_napomena: Check the point found from the address or move it by clicking on the map. The point is public.
gazdinstva.prijava_sledeci_korak: Next step: listings on behalf of the farm and, once the farm accepts members, invitations to farm members.
gazdinstva.polje_ime_prezime_napomena: It is recorded with your account, separately from the farm and from POEN records. Other users do not see it, except the Kolo member who calls you if you asked for someone to call you.
gazdinstva.ime_nedostaje: Approval requires the name and surname of every farm member. Enter yours.
gazdinstva.ime_upisano: Your name and surname have been recorded.
gazdinstva.polje_adresa_napomena: The address is required, and it is shown on the map once you give the statement below. The point is found from the address by the OpenStreetMap service.
gazdinstva.adresa_nadjena: The point was placed by the address. Check it and, if needed, move it by clicking on the map.
gazdinstva.adresa_nije_nadjena: Address not found. Check the street and place, or click on the map.
gazdinstva.izjava_adresa: I consent to the address being displayed next to the point on the map. The display lasts as long as the farm exists on the platform and ends when the farm is deleted.
gazdinstva.adresa_izjava_nedostaje: The farm's address is not written on the map until you give a declaration consenting to its display.
gazdinstva.adresa_izjava_data: The declaration has been given; the address is written next to the point on the map.
gazdinstva.obrisi_potvrda: Delete the farm? The point disappears from the map, listings on behalf of the farm are no longer shown, and the farm's details are deleted. This cannot be undone.
gazdinstva.mapa_prijavi_se_vaucer: Log in to take a voucher
gazdinstva.polje_telefon_napomena: Before approval the Foundation talks with the holder. Enter their number, or yours if the holder has no account on the platform. Only the Foundation sees the number, and it deletes it once it decides on the registration. The conversation is not a confirmation of reality.

header.poen_objasnjenje: A record of your contribution to the community — like an entry in a ledger, not money. Cannot be bought, cannot be exchanged for cash, and has no value outside the system.

status.korisnik_opis: Your account is open, but you are not yet in the Kolo. You post listings, write and transfer POEN. You are brought into the Kolo by someone who knows you personally, and if you know no one, choose “I'd like someone to call me”.
status.clan_bez_potvrde_opis: You have been introduced into the Kolo. You have the same access as a Kolo member, except for actions that require confirmation. A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you.
status.clan_kola_opis: You were confirmed by someone who knows you personally. You confirm people you know personally and introduce into the Kolo those who would like someone to call them.
status.cuvar_kola_opis: A Kolo member with ZRNO entered. You review other people's confirmations, and by activating ZRNO you enter the Upper Kolo.
status.osnivac_opis: An initial Kolo keeper, from whom the chain of confirmations starts.
status.dete_na_cekanju_opis: The account is waiting for a parent to take it over. Until then you make friends in person and see listings as a visitor.
status.dete_sa_roditeljem_opis: A parent has taken over the account. You write to your friends and choose your school; you post listings and re-register POEN once you become a Kolo child.
status.dete_kola_opis: The parent is a Kolo member and it has been confirmed to them that they have this child. The account works in the full scope of the children's space.
status.ceka_roditelj: Waiting for a parent to take over the account.
status.ceka_roditelj_u_kolo: Waiting for the parent to become a Kolo member.
status.ceka_potvrda_postojanja: Waiting for a Kolo member who knows the parent personally to confirm that this is their child.
status.zrno_zamrznuto: Your ZRNO is frozen: it stays entered, but you do not activate it, write it off or delegate your vote until a Kolo member confirms you again.
status.zrno_bez_potvrde: You cannot activate entered ZRNO until a Kolo member confirms you. You can write off free ZRNO.
status.bez_potvrde_ne_mozes: As a member without confirmation, you cannot confirm others or vote.
status.bez_potvrde_ne_spisak: you do not see who would like someone to call them
status.bez_potvrde_ne_dete: you do not confirm the existence of a child
status.uvodilac_ne_dobija: Whoever introduces you into the Kolo gets nothing until you contribute yourself.
status.kolo_nije_clanstvo: Belonging to the Kolo is not membership in the Foundation.
status.potvrdi_te_clan_kola: A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you: show them your code.
status.nazove_obavestenje: A Kolo member will call you. They will see your first and last name, if entered, and your phone number. The Foundation records who opened your data.
status.nazove_veza: I'd like someone to call me →

sistem.clanovi_pregled_blokiran: You can see the overview of all users once you join the Kolo.
sistem.opis_stranice: An overview of the entire KOLO system in numbers: how many of us there are, where we come from, and how much is exchanged. Track the community's health here.
sistem.faza_sistema_opis: When the community records 1,000,000 POEN of contribution, the system automatically moves to Phase 2 and the Upper Circle (shared decision-making) and the recording of ZRNO are activated.
sistem.kartica_opticaj_opis: The total number of POEN currently in the system. Shows how active the community is.
sistem.kartica_racun_fondacije_opis: The Foundation's balance in dinars (inflow from donations and sponsorship, minus expenses). This is not POEN — it is actual funds in dinars.
sistem.lok_uvod: An overview of the places users come from. When enough participants gather in one place, a cooperative can be founded.
sistem.lok_legenda_zadruga: The first cooperative in a place needs {prag} participants from that place and the Foundation's participation. Each subsequent one needs {n} cooperative members.
sistem.fondacija_nema_tx: No recorded entries for the Foundation.
sistem.programi_zbir_opis: Individual entries of social programmes are not published. The daily total per programme is published, with the number of support recipients, so the total of all channels still gives the overall number of recorded POEN.
sistem.rast_opticaja_objasnjenje: When the community records 1,000,000 POEN of contribution, the system moves to Phase 2 and the Upper Circle (shared decision-making) is activated. The threshold measures the community's activity — POEN has no price and no value outside the system.
sistem.zero_sum_ok_opis: Balance check: the sum of all ledger entries is exactly zero. This means no POEN was created out of thin air — everything is recorded correctly.
sistem.donacije_pregled_blokiran: The donations overview is not part of the children's space.

sistem.nula_firme: The first company could be yours.
sistem.nula_skole: The first school comes with the first Kolo child.
sistem.nula_donacije: The first donation has not arrived yet.
sistem.opis_gost: This is what KOLO looks like today, in numbers.
sistem.meta_opis: The KOLO system in numbers: participants, listings, exchanges, farms, cooperatives and the total number of POEN.
sistem.gost_zatvoreno: The list is visible to signed-in users.

novcanik.skener_opis: Scan the recipient's QR code to re-register POEN to them.
novcanik.skener_uputstvo: Point the camera at the QR code of the person you are re-registering POEN to.
novcanik.skener_greska_qr: Invalid QR code. Scan a KOLO QR code for re-registration.
novcanik.send_napomena: A re-registration creates no new POEN: as much as your record decreases, theirs increases by the same amount.
novcanik.send_greska_iznos: Amount must be a positive integer.
novcanik.send_uspeh_opis: {iznos} POEN transferred to the entry of user @{pseudonim}.
novcanik.qr_opis: Show this code to someone re-registering POEN to you — they scan it with their phone.
novcanik.prazno_opis: POEN comes into your record when someone re-registers it to you in an exchange, or when your contribution is recorded: a first listing, a confirmation, a donation or a community task. Start by posting what you offer on the Marketplace.
novcanik.ceka_fondaciju_opis: It is recorded once the Foundation approves your first listing.
novcanik.na_zapisu_opis_dete: This much has been recorded for you. Re-registering to others unlocks once a parent takes the account over.
novcanik.nadoknada_opis: It arose from cancelling an entry that was not covered, for example a cancelled confirmation or transfer, or the end of a farm. It is not a debt and is not collected: POEN that reaches you fills it first. Exchange is not restricted for you, and transferring to someone else opens up once your entry goes above zero.
novcanik.ceka_roditelja: The account is waiting for a parent to take it over. Until then POEN can be re-registered into your record; re-registering to others unlocks once a parent takes the account over.
novcanik.nadoknada_opis_dete: This came off when a friendship ended. The first POEN that arrives fills it in. Everything else works as usual.
novcanik.rezervisano_nabavka_opis: Reserved until the goods are collected. Annulled upon collection, not before; if you do not collect, it returns to your record.
novcanik.send_ceka_opis: {iznos} POEN for {pseudonim} is waiting for the parent's approval. Until then it is not deducted from your entry.
novcanik.zabelezene_potvrde_opis: It is entered when the first contribution of the person the confirmation refers to appears: a posted offer approved by the Foundation, a donation, sponsorship or a completed community task. Until then it is not a POEN entry and is not part of your balance.
novcanik.zabelezene_potvrde_moje: Your {iznos} POEN awaits your first contribution
novcanik.zabelezene_potvrde_tudje: {iznos} POEN for confirmations you gave — awaiting the first contribution of those you confirmed
novcanik.zabelezen_gazdinstvo: Your {iznos} POEN of farm contribution — waiting for your posted listing and your joining the Kolo
novcanik.zabelezene_vidi: See who you are waiting for →

verifikacija.podnaslov_korisnik: Show your code to someone who knows you personally.
verifikacija.podnaslov_bez_potvrde: Show your code to a Kolo member who knows you personally, so they can confirm you.
verifikacija.prijava_link: Something wrong with your confirmation? Report it.
verifikacija.prijava_placeholder: Briefly describe what's wrong (e.g. you don't know the person who confirmed you).
verifikacija.prijava_poslata: Report sent. Oversight will review it.
verifikacija.vn_nema_prava: You cannot confirm or introduce others yet: no one has introduced you into the Kolo or confirmed you yet.
verifikacija.vn_upozorenje_dnevno: This would be confirmation number {redni} for you today. Several confirmations in one day are a sign of possible abuse: confirmation number {prag} is not recorded, and confirming is stopped until midnight.
verifikacija.vn_upozorenje_posle: That was confirmation number {redni} for you today. Confirmation number {prag} on the same day is not recorded — your confirming would then be stopped until midnight, and the Foundation notified.
verifikacija.vn_zaustavljeno_n: Today you have already confirmed {danas, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}. Your confirming is stopped until midnight, and the Foundation has been notified. Everything else works as usual.
verifikacija.vn_potvrdi_obavezno: Tick that you know the person personally.
verifikacija.vn_uspeh_opis_uvodjenje: has been introduced into the Kolo and is now a member without confirmation. A Kolo member who knows them personally can confirm them later.
verifikacija.vn_uspeh_opis_potvrda_clana: has been confirmed and has gone from member without confirmation to Kolo member. This confirmation does not enter POEN.
verifikacija.vn_uputstvo: Ask the person to open KOLO → Confirmation → “Generate code”. Choose a method:
verifikacija.vn_oznaka_napomena: Optional. A private label to help you track whom you confirmed — visible only to you and the Foundation, not public. You can change it later.
verifikacija.vn_potvrda: I confirm that I know this person personally and that I state, on my own responsibility, that they are real, unique, and that the same person accesses the account (Art. 5 of the Proof of Reality Rulebook).
verifikacija.vn_naslov_uvodjenje: Introduce someone you know personally into the Kolo
verifikacija.vn_uputstvo_uvodjenje: As a member without confirmation you don't confirm, you bring people into the Kolo: whoever you bring in becomes a member without confirmation. When a Kolo member confirms you, you will be able to confirm those you brought in. Tell the person to open KOLO → Confirmations → “Show code”. Choose the method:
verifikacija.vn_potvrda_uvodjenje: I am introducing into the Kolo a person I know personally, and on my own responsibility I state that they are real, unique, and that the same person accesses the account (Art. 5 and 5a of the Rulebook on Proof of Reality).
verifikacija.vn_nacin_naslov: How do you know this person?
verifikacija.vn_nacin_telefonom: We got acquainted by phone (from the “They'd like someone to call them” list)
verifikacija.vn_nacin_napomena: After getting to know each other by phone, the user is brought into the Kolo and becomes a member without confirmation. A member without confirmation is confirmed after a phone conversation only by a Kolo keeper, and only after 30 days in the Kolo. If you opened that person's name and number, it is always a phone conversation.
verifikacija.vn_potvrda_telefonom: After the phone conversation, I judge that I know this person well enough to state on my own responsibility that they are real, unique, and that the same person accesses the account (Art. 5 of the Rulebook on Proof of Reality).
verifikacija.qr_uputstvo_bez_potvrde: Show the code to a Kolo member who knows you personally, so they can confirm you. The code is valid for 24 hours.
verifikacija.qr_uspeh_opis_clan_kola: You are now a Kolo member. Everything in the Kolo is open to you, and now you too can confirm people you know personally.
verifikacija.qr_uspeh_opis_uvodjenje: You have been introduced into the Kolo and are now a member without confirmation. Nothing is paid. Confirming others and voting open up for you once a Kolo member who knows you personally confirms you.
verifikacija.oznake_lanac_napomena: When a Kolo member confirms you, you will get the list of connections and can confirm them from it.
verifikacija.qr_uputstvo: Let someone who knows you personally scan the QR or enter the six-digit number. The code is valid for 24 hours.
verifikacija.skener_bez_dozvole: I don't have permission to access the camera. Allow it in your browser settings.
verifikacija.skener_nema_kamere: Camera not found or busy in another application.
verifikacija.skener_uputstvo: Point the camera at the QR code of the person you are confirming.
verifikacija.stablo_bez_verifikovanih: You have not confirmed anyone yet

zrno.glasacka_moc_formula: The number of votes is the square root of active ZRNO: √{aktivno} = {moc} (rounded down).
zrno.kanal_neaktivan: ZRNO is not active yet. It activates when the Protocol reaches −1,000,000 POEN.
zrno.delegacija_opis: Pass your votes ({moc}) to another Kolo keeper. The ZRNO stays yours, and you can always take the votes back. The change takes effect from midnight.
zrno.opis: ZRNO records your position in the community and from it derives your vote in decision-making. Here you subscribe and redeem ZRNO and manage your vote.
zrno.zakazan_opoziv: Revocation scheduled — takes effect at midnight
zrno.koeficijent_objasnjenje: The ratio between the total POEN and the ZRNO available to be recorded — it shows how much POEN you need for one ZRNO. It is not a price and does not express value.
zrno.upis_opis: Entering ZRNO reduces your POEN entry, and ZRNO is entered in your record at the current coefficient. It is carried out at midnight.
zrno.upis_minimum: Recording requires at least {min} POEN in your record.
zrno.upis_max: At most {max} POEN per accounting period (1% of your record).
zrno.upis_na_cekanju: Recording request: {iznos} POEN — executed at midnight.
zrno.otpis_opis: Writing off removes ZRNO from your record and records POEN at the current coefficient. Executed at midnight.
zrno.otpis_priblizno: Approximately {poen} POEN at the current coefficient.
zrno.otpis_na_cekanju: Write-off request: {kolicina} ZRNO — executed at midnight.
zrno.nema_slobodnih: You have no free ZRNO to write off.
zrno.nema_zrna: You have no ZRNO recorded yet.
zrno.status_opis: Activated ZRNO gives a vote in the Upper Kolo. Deactivating returns ZRNO to free. Both execute at midnight.
zrno.greska_zahtev: Error sending the request. Please try again.
zrno.polozaj_zamrznuto: Your ZRNO is frozen. It stays entered in your record, but until you enter the Kolo again you cannot write it off; you can activate it and delegate your vote by it only once a Kolo member confirms you.
zrno.polozaj_bez_potvrde: You cannot activate entered ZRNO until a Kolo member confirms you. You can write off free ZRNO. Until you are confirmed, you have no vote and are not part of the Upper Kolo.
zrno.upis_bez_potvrde_napomena: Entering ZRNO does not make you a Kolo keeper. You will be able to activate entered ZRNO once a Kolo member confirms you; until then you can write it off.
zrno.upis_samo_verifikovan: ZRNO is entered by a Kolo member or a member without confirmation. A user does not enter ZRNO.
zrno.otpis_zamrznuto: Your entered ZRNO is frozen, so you cannot write it off until you enter the Kolo again.
zrno.aktiviranje_samo_cuvar: Only a Kolo keeper activates ZRNO. A Kolo member becomes a Kolo keeper by entering ZRNO.
zrno.delegacija_samo_cuvar: Only a Kolo keeper delegates a vote, and only to another Kolo keeper.
zrno.gornje_kolo_objasnjenje: The Upper Kolo consists of Kolo keepers with active ZRNO. It proposes and votes on decisions for the community, and refers its decisions to the Foundation's Management Board.

programi.prijava_podneta: Your application has been submitted and is awaiting approval.
programi.skolovanje_napomena: Admin sets daily amount. Re-confirmation every 6 months.
programi.majkama_napomena: Base amount: 2,000 POEN/day per child. Coefficients grow with number of children.
programi.opis_majkama_n: base {osnovica} POEN per day per child, reduced by {umanjenje} for each year of age · the coefficient grows with the number of children · duration {trajanje} yrs
programi.opis_starijima_n: {osnovica} + {poGodini} × (age − {od}) POEN per day · for participants aged {od} and over

programi.opis_skolovanje_n: {iznos} POEN per day · re-check every 6 months
programi.nepun_indeks: A social programme is applied for by a participant — a member without confirmation or a Kolo member. Before approval, fulfilment of the conditions is confirmed by a Kolo member who knows you personally, or by the Foundation.
programi.posebna_briga_datum_isteka: Expiry date of the decision (optional — leave empty if permanent)
programi.posebna_briga_osnov_napomena: The basis is not shown to any user. Participants — members without confirmation and Kolo members — see the programme name and amount, never on what grounds you obtained it.
programi.posebna_briga_dokaz_izjava: The proof is your statement, not a document. A right based on acute illness lasts six months, so the application is filed again if the condition persists.
programi.posebna_briga_punoletstvo: Date on which the person in your care comes of age (leave empty if an adult)
programi.posebna_briga_punoletstvo_napomena: Only that date is asked for, because a right exercised for a minor ends when that person comes of age. Their name, condition and other details are not entered.
programi.posebna_briga_datum_dogadjaja: Date of the event (natural disaster, fire, flood or displacement)
programi.posebna_briga_dom_napomena: The proof is your statement. The right lasts twelve months from the event and ends when that period expires, without review.
programi.posebna_briga_napomena2: What counts is that the decision exists, not what it says: the decision number, the authority, the degree of disability, the assessment of working capacity, medical documentation and the diagnosis are not requested. The right is subject to annual review.
programi.pristanak_tekst: I consent to {broj} Kolo members who know me personally being asked to confirm that I meet the condition for this programme; confirmation by one of them is sufficient. They learn which programme it is — which may reveal information about health, family or age — but they do not see the data entered. Recording of POEN under this programme is shown to participants — members without confirmation and Kolo members — with my pseudonym, the programme name and the amount; for the Support for the Elderly programme my year of birth can be derived from the amount, and for the Support for Mothers programme the number and age of children. The basis on which I exercise the right is not shown to any user. The Foundation approves the application only once fulfilment of the condition has been confirmed. I can withdraw consent at any time.
programi.pristanak_tekst_fondacija: I consent to the Foundation establishing whether I meet the condition for this programme, because I have no Kolo member who knows me personally and could confirm it; a Kolo member who only brought me into the Kolo after a phone conversation does not confirm this. Recording of POEN under this programme is shown to participants — members without confirmation and Kolo members — with my pseudonym, the programme name and the amount; for the Support for the Elderly programme my year of birth can be derived from the amount, and for the Support for Mothers programme the number and age of children. The basis on which I exercise the right is not shown to any user. I can withdraw consent at any time.
programi.potvrde_opis: Participants you know personally have applied for a social programme. As a Kolo member, confirm that the person meets the condition, or explain why you cannot. You do not see the details entered in the application.
programi.potvrde_prazno: You have no confirmation requests at the moment.
programi.potvrda_obrazlozenje_obavezno: An explanation is required when rejecting.
programi.povuci_potvrda: Withdrawing consent stops the procedure, recording of POEN under this programme ends, and the data entered is deleted. A new application starts from the beginning, including a new confirmation that the conditions are met. Continue?
programi.povuci_uspeh: Consent withdrawn. The data you entered has been deleted.

donacije.beta_opis: Payment by card and IPS QR code will be enabled soon. Until then, donate by bank transfer to the Foundation's account, quoting your reference number.
donacije.objasnjenje: A donation is non-refundable and acquires nothing. Following a donation the Protocol records a contribution in your record, at the coefficient of the level reached.
donacije.placanje_uspeh: The payment has been received. POEN is recorded when the Foundation confirms the payment; you will see it in the history below.
donacije.placanje_neuspeh: Payment was not approved (the bank declined the transaction). No payment has been recorded.
donacije.placanje_greska: Something went wrong while processing the payment. If the amount was charged, contact support.
donacije.karticno_opis: Secure payment on the bank's page (3D Secure). Card data is not stored on the platform.
donacije.vidljivost_javna: Public donation (POEN is recorded for me)
donacije.vidljivost_javna_opis: Your first and last name will be shown publicly in the donation list. POEN is recorded only for a public donation.
donacije.vidljivost_anonimna_opis: Your name is not shown. No POEN is recorded for an anonymous donation.
donacije.vidljivost_upozorenje: With a public donation, your name can be linked to your pseudonym and your record. You can withdraw your name from the list whenever you like, and it is also deleted when you close your account; anything someone has already seen outside the platform is not erased by this.
donacije.lista_opis: Public donors are shown by first and last name, with the amount and date, without a pseudonym. An anonymous donation enters the list by amount and date only.
donacije.lista_zakljucana: The list of donations is not available in a child's account. Your own donations are shown above.
donacije.ips_opis: Scan the QR code with your mobile bank — the payment in dinars arrives within seconds, with no platform fee. POEN is recorded once the Foundation confirms the incoming payment.
donacije.ips_uskoro: The Foundation's account for IPS payments will be opened soon. This option will activate automatically once the account is configured.
donacije.ips_limit: Maximum per IPS payment: RSD {max}. Pay larger amounts by card or by regular transfer.
donacije.ips_greska: QR code generation is not possible right now.
donacije.ips_skeniraj_uputstvo: Open mobile banking → “Pay / Scan QR” → scan this code. The amount and the reference number are already filled in — just confirm.
donacije.ips_napomena_potvrda: After payment, the Foundation confirms the incoming amount by the reference number, and POEN is recorded then. The reference number is already in the QR code — do not change it.
donacije.vas_broj_opis: This is your permanent reference number (model 97). Quote it with every payment: it is how the payment is recognised as yours. The bank rejects a mistyped number.
donacije.rang_pojasnjenje: A larger single contribution has greater significance for the community. This is not a discount — a donation acquires nothing.
donacije.povuci_ime_potvrda: Your first and last name will be removed from the list of donations and deleted from the record of this donation. The donation stays in the list with its amount, date and pseudonym, and POEN does not change. The name cannot be restored afterwards. Continue?
donacije.povuci_ime_greska: The name was not withdrawn. Please try again.
donacije.ugovor_napomena: The agreement was drawn up at the moment the donation was confirmed and has not changed since. The Serbian original is authoritative.
donacije.karticno_sopstvena_kartica: By paying you confirm that the card is in your name. The contribution is recorded only for the person whose funds were used for the payment.
donacije.karticno_kapa: A card payment can be at most {max} RSD. For a larger amount use a bank transfer or an international remittance.
donacije.karticno_kapa_napomena: Card payments go up to {max} RSD. A larger amount goes by bank transfer (domestic) or international remittance (from abroad).
donacije.karticno_nepovratnost: I confirm that the donation is non-refundable and that I receive no goods or services for it.
donacije.karticno_nepovratnost_obavezna: Confirm that the donation is non-refundable before you continue.

landing.meta_title: KOLO — an exchange system you build with your community
landing.meta_desc: KOLO is a system in which people from the same area exchange work, goods and knowledge without money, and every contribution stays on record.
landing.hero_naslov: Exchange you build with people from your area
landing.hero_podnaslov: Work, goods and knowledge circulate among people. We are starting in Sombor and its surroundings, and we welcome people from every place.
landing.problem_1_naslov: Food travels, while it grows right next to us.
landing.problem_1_opis: We buy honey, eggs, cheese and vegetables that have crossed thousands of kilometres, while someone in the neighbourhood produces exactly that.
landing.problem_2_naslov: The producer has no one to sell to.
landing.problem_2_opis: All that's left is a buyer who dictates the price, or a stall where you stand all day. The demand is there, the supply is there, the channel is not.
landing.problem_3_opis: The neighbour is a skilled tradesman, the woman next door makes the best cheese around, their son gives lessons. And only the people closest to them know it.
landing.alternativa_podnaslov: All three problems have the same cause: people who are close are not connected. Through KOLO we connect in three ways.
landing.alternativa_1_opis: A neighbour, a friend, a friend of a friend, and then someone from the next village you don't know yet. Every exchange is a connection that wasn't there before.
landing.alternativa_2_opis_start: When you give someone work, goods or knowledge, they transfer to you
landing.alternativa_2_opis_end: , as much as you asked for. It is a record of your contribution; it is not money and is not exchanged for dinars.
landing.alternativa_3_naslov: The rules are the same for everyone
landing.alternativa_3_opis: The rules of the system and the way decisions are made are written down and anyone can read them. They are not changed in favour of an individual. Until the public opening they are set by the founder with the Foundation, and from then on the community decides on them through the Upper Kolo.
landing.kome_1_opis: Your produce goes straight to the people looking for it, with no middleman in between.
landing.kome_2_opis: People where you live see what you do and recommend you for work you have actually done.
landing.kome_3_opis: You know how to repair, advise, teach. What you give stays on record, and someone helps you too when you need it.
landing.kome_4_opis: Preserves, baking, handmade goods — everything made at home has someone nearby looking for it.
landing.kome_5_opis: Childcare, homemade food, a hand around the house — from people you know, or people known to someone you trust.
landing.kome_6_naslov: Young people and those just starting out
landing.kome_6_opis: Your first people to work for, and room to show what you can do. You need neither capital nor a company, just someone to give you the first chance.
landing.kome_firme_opis: Support the community you work in, with money or with goods and services that people from your area take up with vouchers.
landing.primer_korak_1_naslov: Ana and Milan meet through an exchange
landing.primer_korak_1_opis: Milan from Sombor needs honey, and Ana from Bezdan produces it. For five jars she asked for 5,000 POEN, and Milan transferred them to her.
landing.primer_korak_2_opis: Ana's washing machine broke down. Lazar from Stanišić repaired it, and Ana transferred 4,000 POEN to him. She didn't pay a single dinar, and Lazar now has a record of his work.
landing.primer_korak_3_opis: Lazar felt like having burek. Marija baked him a tray of it, he re-registered 1,000 POEN to her, and she used them for a jar of Ana's honey.
landing.primer_most: At the start they did not know one another. Now they are in the same circle.
landing.primer_napomena_1: It is a record of what each person has given to the community.
landing.primer_napomena_2: The amount in POEN is proposed by whoever posts the listing and agreed between the two sides. The Foundation publishes no ratio by which POEN would be exchanged for dinars, or dinars for POEN, and recommends none. A donor's contribution is recorded under a public rulebook, one-way and without any claim against the Foundation. POEN is not bought for dinars and is not exchanged for dinars.
landing.kako_funkcionise_link_postupak: The whole process, step by step
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_1_opis: It takes about a minute. You choose a nickname instead of your name, and no documents are needed.
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_2_opis: You can post a listing right away, without anyone's confirmation.
landing.kako_funkcionise_korak_3_opis: Someone who knows you personally confirms that you are a real person or brings you into the Kolo. When you make your first contribution, 1,000 POEN is entered for both you and them.

oNama.hero_opis: The platform is working and is now in testing. Here you can read how KOLO came about, where it is now and how you can help.
oNama.citat_tekst: As a doctor, my calling is to help people. I believe the society we live in is arranged for the same reason. Every day in my surgery I see people the system ought to help but cannot. Farmers, pensioners, mothers, people who are ill and who still have a great deal to give. Everyone has their place in society and something to contribute. All they need is the infrastructure — the tools and a community behind them.
oNama.prica_p1: Nikola Šarić first had doubts while still at medical school, when he saw how much the incentives in the profession, from the pharmaceutical industry to the way it is financed, push medicine towards treating consequences instead of protecting health. He later recognised the same logic in food production, in the economy and in the labour market. He finished medicine because he concluded that a system is easier to change from the inside.
oNama.prica_p2: Alongside medicine he spent years studying systems in which people exchange work and goods without money as an intermediary. He learned from Thomas Greco, one of the best-known theorists of such systems, and presented the idea at public talks in Stanišić, Sombor, Novi Sad and Belgrade.
oNama.prica_p3: Over the years the idea changed name and form. Today it is KOLO, with complete documentation, a registered Foundation and a platform that works. The structure is set up so that over time it works independently of any individual, including him.
oNama.status_opis: The system is being built step by step. It moves from one step to the next not when a deadline passes, but when the conditions are met. The first step is behind us; we are in the second now.
oNama.faza1_opis: The platform is built, the documentation written, the rules set, and the KOLO Foundation entered in the business register (APR).
oNama.faza2_prelaz: When the community records 1,000,000 POEN of contribution.
oNama.faza3_opis: ZRNO and the Upper Kolo switch on, and from then on the community proposes and adopts the rules of the system, while the Foundation implements them in accordance with its acts. The system is complete and ready for full public testing.
oNama.faza3_prelaz: When the first cooperative starts working.
oNama.faza4_opis: The Marketplace fills with offers, and people come on recommendation and invite others. Enough people are inside that most of those who come to the Marketplace find something they need, register and post their own listing.
oNama.faza4_prelaz: When donations permanently cover the Foundation's running costs and cooperatives are working in several places.
oNama.faza5_opis: The system no longer depends on individual donors or on the founders; the rules of the system are set by the community. Local people begin, on their own initiative, to found cooperatives, without organisational or financial support from the Foundation.
oNama.faza5_prelaz: When local people found a cooperative on their own for the first time and the Foundation sends a proposal for cooperation to local governments and the competent institutions.
oNama.faza6_opis: Cooperatives and communities from more and more places connect and exchange with each other. What the community does closer to people and better, it takes over itself: care for the elderly and the sick, passing on knowledge and food production.
oNama.faza6_prelaz: This is the horizon, not a stop.
oNama.otvaranje_opis: We are checking the whole flow in practice, with real people and real exchange. Nothing here is a simulation.
oNama.stavka1_tekst: The whole path a user goes through: registration, joining the Kolo, entering and transferring POEN, the Marketplace, programmes, donations, cooperatives and farms.
oNama.stavka2_tekst: We check that every record holds: the balance of accounts, the nightly calculations and the record of contributions. The aim is for the figures to be right down to the last POEN.
oNama.stavka3_tekst: We are looking for errors and possible abuse now, while the system is small and the damage is small. It is the only moment when this can be done cheaply.
oNama.stavka4_tekst: Everything you enter stays. Your account, your POEN, the contributions recorded and the history of your exchanges carry over into the next step. This testing is not a trial run that gets wiped.
oNama.stavka5_tekst: The public opening comes when the community records 1,000,000 POEN of contribution. Then ZRNO and the Upper Kolo switch on by themselves, and the community begins to decide on the rules. Registration is open until then as well.
oNama.ukljucivanje_naslov: The system is built through different forms of contribution
oNama.ukljucivanje_opis: Whether you have five minutes, knowledge, means or an acquaintance, there is a way to help.
oNama.k3_tekst: If you are a programmer, a designer or work in IT, we need help with the platform. The code is open, so you can look at it before getting in touch. Even a few hours a month help.
oNama.sek1_tekst: Writers, journalists, video producers and designers, as well as academics in economics, law and the social sciences. Most of all we need someone who can say complex ideas in the language of farmers, pensioners and twenty-year-olds.
oNama.sek2_tekst: Experience in running a company, an association or larger organisations. There is more work in the Foundation than one person can manage.
oNama.sek3_tekst: Lawyers with an interest in cooperative law, foundation law and questions around digital platforms, as well as accountants with experience in the non-profit sector.
oNama.sek4_tekst: Contacts in the cooperative movement, producer associations, trade unions, civil society and local government. All of it speeds up the spread of the system where it makes the most sense.
oNama.sek5_tekst: If you can gather your neighbours, an association or a local community, or provide a space for a public talk, get in touch. Sombor and its surroundings come first, but every place is welcome.
oNama.stub1_tekst: The Foundation is the legal backbone of the system. It receives cash donations from citizens and signs sponsorship agreements with companies, associations and registered farms. It covers the platform's costs, represents the system before institutions and does not distribute profit.
oNama.stub3_tekst: The Management Board makes strategic decisions, and the director runs operations. From the public opening, the Upper Kolo refers decisions to the Foundation, which implements them and responds to every recommendation with reasons and publicly.
oNama.kontakt_opis: For anything the frequently asked questions don't cover, email us. We answer personally.
oNama.cta_opis: The system is running, the documentation is public, the code is open.
oNama.cta_opis2: All that is left is to come in and see what is useful to you.

oSistemu.zajednicko_p1: Acquaintances, work, knowledge, goods, time and the infrastructure the Foundation maintains all pass through KOLO. All of it leaves a trace, because it strengthens connections, knowledge and trust, which remain available to everyone.
oSistemu.zajednicko_p2_sredina: the common good of the KOLO system
oSistemu.zajednicko_p2_post: . It is nobody's property, but it is everybody's concern. The rules are shared, and it is maintained by those who use it.
oSistemu.arhitektura_zadruge_tekst: A cooperative is an independent legal entity, registered under the Law on Cooperatives, with a cooperation agreement with the Foundation. It has its own entry in the Protocol and itself decides how much POEN it records there. A cooperative is managed by its members, and the Foundation has neither a vote nor a share in it.
oSistemu.topla_voda_tag: We are not reinventing the wheel
oSistemu.topla_voda_naslov: This already works elsewhere, and has for decades
oSistemu.zasto_p1: Bačka has one of the oldest cooperative traditions in Europe. The Gazdovský spolok in Bački Petrovac, founded in 1846, is still listed among the first cooperatives in the world. Older people here remember cooperatives, farmsteads and helping each other in the fields first-hand, and KOLO builds on that habit of mutual help.
oSistemu.zasto_p2: Sombor is large enough for the effects of a network to show, and small enough to see who is producing them. A town ringed by homesteads and villages means the craftsman, the pensioner, the housewife, the young mother and the farmer are all in the same place. It also means that those of us building this live here, so whatever does not work is not something we can fail to notice.
oSistemu.zasto_citat: One hand washes the other, and both wash the face.
oSistemu.nismo_uvod: Communities in various countries have been organising exchange themselves for decades, with a unit that is not money but enables exchange within the network. This field is called the social and solidarity economy. KOLO is one attempt within it, adapted to Serbian law and local needs.
oSistemu.nismo_wir: A mutual credit network among businesses, founded at the height of the Great Depression. Today more than fifty thousand small and medium-sized businesses operate in it, and when the official economy weakens, exchange in WIR grows.
oSistemu.nismo_lets: A local network in which members exchange work, goods and services with their own unit of account, and the sum of all accounts is always zero. It spreads quickly, but it has also shown a limit: a network that isn't used every day fades away over time.
oSistemu.nismo_sardex: A mutual credit network among local businesses, born in the debt crisis, without interest and without a large investment. It showed that a local team can build a sustainable network in about ten years.
oSistemu.nismo_fureai: Members who help the elderly record the hours they work and can use them for themselves or pass them to a family member in another part of the country. It grew into hundreds of organisations with around one hundred thousand users.
oSistemu.nismo_razlika1: Those networks create a unit of exchange. KOLO creates a record of contribution, and exchange is what follows from it.
oSistemu.nismo_razlika2: The reality of everyone who joins the Kolo is established by a person who answers for it — either someone who knows them personally, or a Kolo member after a phone conversation with them.
oSistemu.nismo_razlika3: Contribution and vote don't mix, because POEN records what you give and ZRNO carries the vote.
oSistemu.nismo_razlika4: WIR obtained a banking licence in 1936 because it gives credit to its members, while KOLO gives no credit. Sardex is a company that charges an annual membership fee, while joining KOLO is free.
oSistemu.nismo_razlika5: What you agree on and hand over to each other is the exchange. POEN is only a record of it. The record by itself does not oblige anyone to anything.

pravnaPozicija.hero_opis: How KOLO is qualified under Serbian law, and why. The provisions each statement rests on are cited alongside it.
pravnaPozicija.uvod: The KOLO system is not a payment institution, an issuer of digital assets, a collective investment scheme or an employer (Rulebook art. 69). That qualification does not rest on a declaration but on the structure of the system — on what POEN and ZRNO are, how they come about, and what cannot be done with them.
pravnaPozicija.poen_uvod: POEN is an internal unit of account that records contribution. It has no holder and exists solely as an entry in the Protocol's ledger (art. 12–13). It follows that it is not:
pravnaPozicija.zrno_uvod: ZRNO is an internal unit of account that records a user's standing, from which a vote in the Upper Circle follows. The Rulebook qualifies it explicitly (art. 18):
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije1: A share, a stock or a security
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije2: A unit of collective investment or an investment contract
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije4: It carries no dividend, interest or yield
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije5: It grants no right to a liquidation remainder
pravnaPozicija.zrno_nije6: It is not transferred to another user and is not inherited as a property right (art. 22, 34, 72)
pravnaPozicija.zasto_naslov: Why this is more than a statement
pravnaPozicija.zasto1_tekst: It cannot be given, sold or assigned to another user (art. 22). There is therefore no secondary market — no one to sell it to, at any price.
pravnaPozicija.zasto2_naslov: The dinar enters the Foundation, not the ledger
pravnaPozicija.zasto2_tekst: Donations in dinars do exist, and a donor's contribution is recorded in POEN — but these are two legally independent acts. Dinar funds enter the Foundation and do not enter the accounting framework of the system (art. 38). The recording is not consideration for the donation, there is no contract exchanging dinars for POEN, and a donor has no claim to have POEN recorded (art. 73). A donation is non-refundable.
pravnaPozicija.zasto3_naslov: The exit does not lead to money
pravnaPozicija.zasto3_tekst: Writing ZRNO off yields POEN, and POEN has no value outside the system and cannot be converted into money (art. 70, 78). The exit leads into another internal entry, not outside.
pravnaPozicija.zasto4_naslov: The vote is not proportional to the number of ZRNO
pravnaPozicija.zasto4_tekst: Voting power is the integer square root of the number of active ZRNO (art. 46), so it grows much more slowly than the number of ZRNO: a hundred ZRNO give ten votes, not a hundred.
pravnaPozicija.zasto5_naslov: No inheritance, no claim on assets
pravnaPozicija.zasto5_tekst: POEN and ZRNO entries are not transferred and not inherited as property rights (art. 34, 72), and constitute no claim against the Foundation.
pravnaPozicija.zasto6_naslov: The coefficient is not an exchange rate
pravnaPozicija.zasto6_tekst: The accounting coefficient is the ratio between the total POEN recorded and the ZRNO available to be recorded. The Protocol computes it automatically and without discretion. It is not a price, not an exchange rate and not a performance index, and it expresses no value of ZRNO or POEN outside the system (art. 23). A change in a Kolo keeper's standing is not a yield and is not guaranteed (art. 25).
pravnaPozicija.propisi_naslov: Why it falls outside those statutes
pravnaPozicija.propisi_uvod: The qualification does not rest on a declaration but on POEN and ZRNO failing the statutory definitions. Below is the test against each statute.
pravnaPozicija.zdi_tekst:
The Digital Assets Act (art. 2) defines a digital asset as a digital record of value that can be digitally bought, sold, exchanged or transferred and that can be used as a means of exchange or for investment purposes. A virtual currency is the form that no central bank issued and that has no legal status of money, but which people accept as a means of exchange. Those forms of disposal are alternatives (it is enough that one is met), so the defence cannot rest on POEN having no status of money: the definition itself assumes that.

What POEN does meet, and this is not concealed: no central bank issued it, and on the Marketplace users accept it as a means of exchange for goods and services.

What it does not meet: it cannot be acquired by purchase, because the Foundation does not sell it, sets no price for it and does not offer it on a market, and recording is not consideration for a donation; it cannot be disposed of for consideration, which the Terms of Use expressly prohibit; there is no buy-back, no conversion into money and no secondary market, so there is no price to trade at; it does not exist outside the ledger kept by the Protocol and cannot be transferred outside it, because updating the records between two users does not take POEN out of the system; and it is not used for investment purposes, as there is no yield and no issuer promising one.

On the basis of POEN the Foundation provides no payment services, holds no funds of users and executes no payment transactions. This is our reading, stated openly; the assessment is for the competent authority.
pravnaPozicija.zps_tekst:
A payment transaction presupposes a transfer of monetary value between a payer and a payee. No such transfer occurs: POEN has neither monetary value nor a holder, so when a user initiates a re-registration, the Protocol changes its own database and nothing of monetary value changes hands.

Nor is POEN electronic money. The Act requires three cumulative conditions, and POEN meets none: it is not issued upon receipt of funds (it is recorded on the basis of a user's activity, and a donation to the Foundation and the recording of a contribution are legally separate acts), it does not serve to execute payment transactions, and it has no issuer in the legal sense.
pravnaPozicija.ztk_tekst: ZRNO is not a transferable security, because it is non-transferable; there is no transfer mechanism, no market and no possibility of trading. Nor is it a unit of collective investment, since it does not represent participation in a fund whose value depends on the assets the funds were invested in; ZRNO records a standing within an accounting system that has no asset value outside itself. POEN is not a financial instrument because it has no holder, cannot be transferred outside the ledger kept by the Protocol and cannot be converted into money. No user invests funds expecting a financial return.
pravnaPozicija.sporno_uvod: Two features of the mechanics invite the question themselves. Both have been examined and both have an explicit answer.
pravnaPozicija.sporno2_naslov: The difference in the coefficient between recording and write-off
pravnaPozicija.sporno2_tekst: Someone who records ZRNO at one coefficient and writes it off at another receives a different number of POEN than they used when recording, because the coefficient rises with new POEN records and falls when they are annulled. Four things break the reading of that difference as a yield: the POEN received has no value outside the system, as it cannot be converted, taken out or cashed in; a change of the coefficient is not guaranteed and depends on the state of the whole community's ledger, not on the efforts of third parties; one's own recording and write-off do not shift the coefficient, because upon recording both the number of POEN in circulation and the number of available ZRNO fall at the same time, so there is neither trading nor a right moment; and there is no issuer promising a rise nor an institution paying the difference. On top of that, whoever wants a vote must activate their ZRNO and thereby loses the option of writing off, so passive holding and governance exclude each other.
pravnaPozicija.principi_tekst: Every argument above rests on POEN having no value outside the system — and that holds only as long as no conversion mechanism exists. Non-convertibility is therefore the first of the four principles the legal position rests on (art. 70), together with the absence of property rights over the entries, the non-refundability of donations, and data minimisation. Those four are structural limits: they cannot be amended or abolished by any governance decision, including a decision of the Upper Circle. Breaching any of them changes the legal nature of the system.
pravnaPozicija.fondacija_tekst: KOLO Foundation, entered in the Register of Endowments and Foundations at the Serbian Business Registers Agency, seated in Sombor, Šetalište 16. Registration number 28836627 · Tax ID 115840443. The Foundation distributes no profit; everything it receives returns to the system. It is the data controller within the meaning of the Personal Data Protection Act.
pravnaPozicija.licence_tekst: The software is open under AGPL-3.0, the content under CC BY-SA 4.0. The licences cannot be replaced with more restrictive ones — neither by the Foundation nor by the Upper Circle.
pravnaPozicija.gde_naslov: Where it is set out in full
pravnaPozicija.gde_uvod: Every statement on this page rests on a published act. Their text governs, not this overview.
pravnaPozicija.porez_tekst:
Personal income tax applies to income from all sources, including income realised in non-monetary form. The question is therefore not whether something is remuneration, but whether the user received anything at all.

With POEN, they did not. The recording brings neither money nor goods, nothing passes from the Foundation's assets into the user's assets, the record so created cannot be turned into money, assigned or collected, and the Foundation neither determines nor publishes a value of POEN expressed in money. The Foundation pays no money to a user on any basis.

With a collective procurement, they did, and this is not concealed: the user receives a good purchased with the Foundation's dinar funds. The good is provided free of charge and without any consideration, in pursuit of the Foundation's registered objectives. The annulled record is extinguished and does not pass to the Foundation; it is not a unit acquired in order to collect the share, but the record of a contribution the user had already made to the common good.

What remains contested: how the competent authority will qualify that provision. The Foundation gives no tax advice and guarantees no tax treatment; users are responsible for their own tax obligations.
pravnaPozicija.zzp_tekst:
Rules on unfair commercial practice bind a trader, that is, a person acting on the market within their own business activity. The Foundation does not act that way towards users: it does not offer them goods or services for consideration, does not charge for use of the Platform, does not mediate in exchange, and receives no value on account of exchange between users. The amount in a listing is set by the user alone; the Foundation publishes no ratio of POEN to the dinar, recommends none, and applies none in any of its own procedures.

Between users, consumer protection rules apply just as they would off the Platform. Where goods or a service are offered by a person doing so within a business activity, a user acquiring them for their own needs has rights under those rules and exercises them against that person. Compliance with rules on business registration, on production and trade, on food safety and with tax rules is the responsibility of whoever offers the goods or service.

What remains contestable: the Foundation does not establish in what capacity a user is acting and does not ask them to declare it, so the other side cannot tell from the listing. In its form the Platform is a place where goods and services are offered, and this is not concealed. This is our reading, stated openly; the assessment is for the competent authority.
pravnaPozicija.sporno1_tekst_prag: Someone who donates dinars to the Foundation gets POEN recorded, which may bring them closer to the threshold for entering ZRNO. Three things break the reading of that chain as an investment contract: the donation is non-refundable and legally separate from the recording, so a donor can neither condition it on the recording nor demand a refund; the donation is neither a necessary nor a privileged route to ZRNO, because the same threshold of {prag} POEN is reached through exchange, contribution and confirmations, without a single dinar; and the ratio between the donated amount and the number of POEN is not a fixed conversion rate but a system parameter.
pravnaPozicija.okvir_naslov: The framework of the social and solidarity economy
pravnaPozicija.okvir_tekst: In recent years the social and solidarity economy has received an agreed definition and the support of international bodies: the European Union Action Plan (2021), the Resolution of the International Labour Organization (2022), UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/77/281 (2023) and the Council of the EU Recommendation (2023). This framework concerns Serbia through the accession negotiations, formally through Chapters 19 and 22. None of these documents is a binding regulation.
pravnaPozicija.okvir_merilo: The features in those definitions (shared decision-making, returning everything to the system, public rules, voluntary participation) are already built into the way KOLO works, and POEN is not an object of trade. This does not mean that any authority or international body has approved KOLO, but that there is a yardstick against which KOLO can be checked.

kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije_kratko: POEN is a record of what you gave — an entry in a ledger, not money you hold. There is no way to buy it or sell it for dinars, neither from us nor from anyone else.
kakoFunkcionisePage.sistem_hero_opis: You don't need to know this to get started. Here you can read how POEN comes about and how ZRNO works.
kakoFunkcionisePage.meta_title: How KOLO works: steps, mechanics and who is behind it
kakoFunkcionisePage.meta_desc: How you join KOLO, the channels through which POEN comes about, how ZRNO works, who started the system and how it is legally organised. All on one page.
kakoFunkcionisePage.hero_opis: KOLO is a system in which people from the same area exchange work, goods and knowledge without money, and every contribution stays on record.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k1_opis: Email, nickname and password. No documents are needed. On the Marketplace and in exchange others see you by your nickname, and you enter your name, phone and place only if you want to.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k2_naslov: What you can do straight away
kakoFunkcionisePage.k2_opis: You immediately see all listings on the Marketplace and post your own, offering or looking for something. You write in the Chat room and to advertisers about their listings, and you receive and transfer POEN. Listing contacts, programmes, procurements and vouchers open up once you join the Kolo.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k3_opis:
A Kolo member who knows you personally confirms that you are a real person, and you become a Kolo member. You can also be brought in by an acquaintance who was brought in themselves, and then you are a member without confirmation until a Kolo member who knows you personally confirms you. If you don't know anyone, choose “I'd like someone to call me” and a Kolo member will call you and, after the conversation, can bring you in.
1,000 POEN is noted for you and for the person who confirmed you or brought you in, and it is recorded when you make your first contribution.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k3_detalj: in the Kolo right away · 1,000 POEN with your first contribution
kakoFunkcionisePage.k4_opis: In the Kolo you see listing contacts, write without a daily limit and apply for programmes, procurements, vouchers and the cooperative in your place. You bring people you know personally into the Kolo, and as a Kolo member you also confirm them and call those who want someone to call them.
kakoFunkcionisePage.k5_opis: A Kolo member who enters ZRNO becomes a Kolo keeper and gets a vote in the Upper Kolo, which adopts proposals on the rules of the system. ZRNO and the Upper Kolo switch on when the community records 1,000,000 POEN of contribution.
kakoFunkcionisePage.odgovornost_tekst: Anyone who confirms or brings into the Kolo someone who is not a real person loses those 1,000 POEN, and if they have already spent them, their entry goes below zero. For abuse they lose the right to confirm, and for repeated abuse they can be excluded.
kakoFunkcionisePage.evidencija_naslov: {broj} channels through which POEN comes about in a personal entry
kakoFunkcionisePage.kanali_zadruga_napomena: Besides these channels, the Protocol also records POEN in a cooperative's entry when the number of its members reaches a growth threshold. That POEN belongs to no one personally.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n1_opis: Your first listing offering a good or service, with a photo, description and place. It appears on the Marketplace right away, and POEN is recorded when the Foundation approves it.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_jeste2: Does not expire while you have an account
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_jeste4: The basis on which ZRNO is recorded
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije3: Digital assets or a cryptocurrency (Law on Digital Assets)
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije4: A financial instrument or an investment scheme (Capital Markets Law)
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije5: A claim against the Foundation or a property right of the user
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_nije6: A thing existing outside the ledger — POEN is a record and nothing else
kakoFunkcionisePage.zerosum_naslov: How POEN comes about and how it moves
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_uvod: ZRNO is what a Kolo keeper keeps. It is not spent, not sold and not transferred, and from it comes a vote in deciding on the rules of the system. It switches on when the community records 1,000,000 POEN of contribution.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis2: The total quantity of ZRNO is fixed at 1,000,000, and that number never changes.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis3: How much POEN is needed for one ZRNO is set by the accounting coefficient, which changes with the amount of POEN in circulation and can also fall.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis4: ZRNO is not transferred and stays with the person who entered it.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi1: Active ZRNO gives a Kolo keeper a vote in the Upper Kolo and cannot be written off while it is active.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi2: The number of votes is the square root of the number of active ZRNO, so someone with a hundred ZRNO has ten votes.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi4: You can hand your votes to another Kolo keeper — the votes only, never the ZRNO.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_koristi5: Free ZRNO can be written off back to the Protocol, giving you POEN at the current coefficient.
kakoFunkcionisePage.koeficijent_naslov: How the accounting coefficient is calculated
kakoFunkcionisePage.koeficijent_tekst:
The accounting coefficient is the ratio of the number of entered POEN to the available ZRNO, and it tells how much POEN is needed for one ZRNO at a given moment.
Someone who enters ZRNO at one coefficient and writes it off at another gets a different number of POEN than they used up when entering it, because the coefficient rises with new POEN entries and falls with their cancellation. Nothing here is guaranteed, and ZRNO is not an investment. The coefficient is not a price and does not express the value of ZRNO outside the system.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n7_opis: Recognition of the founders for what they invested before the system existed: years of work on the concept and the acts, building the platform, registering the Foundation, visits and public talks, tools and services they paid for themselves, and above all their free time, without a single dinar of compensation.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n6_opis:
You donate money to the Foundation, and your contribution is recorded in POEN under a public rulebook, with a donation coefficient by which the community acknowledges the contribution, because a larger contribution matters more to it.
The record is one-way: POEN is not converted back into dinars, gives no ownership or claim against the Foundation and does not buy votes.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n5_opis: A company, association or registered farm signs a sponsorship agreement with the Foundation, in money or in goods and services. POEN is recorded for the user who submitted the application, using the same table as for donations.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n4_opis: Programmes for mothers and guardians, the elderly, special support and schooling, in which POEN is entered for approved participants every day. This is not social assistance within the meaning of the regulations and does not affect the rights you have with the state.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n3_opis: Concrete work for the community. Until the Upper Kolo is established, a task is published by the Foundation on behalf of the community, and after that by Kolo keepers. POEN is recorded when completion is confirmed. The Rulebook calls this operational contribution.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n2_opis: When someone who knows you confirms you or brings you into the Kolo, 1,000 POEN is noted for you and for them, and it is recorded when you make your first contribution. A later confirmation of a member without confirmation brings no new POEN.
kakoFunkcionisePage.poen_uvod_zapis: POEN is a record of what you give to the community. It comes about only through the contribution channels listed above.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zerosum_tekst_prepis:
When the Protocol enters new POEN, it enters the same amount below zero for itself, so the sum of all entries is always zero.
Nothing new comes about in an exchange, because POEN is only transferred from one person to another.
kakoFunkcionisePage.zrno_upis_prag: You enter ZRNO yourself, from the POEN in your entry, when you are in the Kolo. Entering requires at least {prag} POEN, and in one period you can enter at most 1% of your entry. A member without confirmation does not activate entered ZRNO until a Kolo member confirms them.
kakoFunkcionisePage.n8_opis_poen: Children from the age of seven have their own space. A friendship is made in person, by scanning a code, and {iznos} POEN is entered for each of them when both children are Kolo children, that is, when the parent is a Kolo member and it has been confirmed that they have that child.
kakoFunkcionisePage.dete_red: Do you have a child aged seven or older?
kakoFunkcionisePage.dete_link: How a child gets an account →
kakoFunkcionisePage.n9_opis: When the Foundation approves a farm, {prvi} POEN is noted for the first member, and {ostali} each for the second to the {max}th member. It is recorded when the member has a posted listing offering something and is in the Kolo.

zajednickoDobroPage.meta_desc: The common good of the KOLO system: software under AGPL-3.0 and content under CC BY-SA 4.0. It belongs to the community; nobody has a property right over it.
zajednickoDobroPage.opis: The common good of the KOLO system comprises the system software, the system rules, the contribution and participation ledger, and content created within the system.
zajednickoDobroPage.softver_tekst: The system source code is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3.0 (AGPL-3.0-only).
zajednickoDobroPage.sadrzaj_tekst: Content created within the system is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).
zajednickoDobroPage.doprinosi_tekst: Software contributions are accepted under the DCO (Developer Certificate of Origin). Every commit must be signed (Signed-off-by).
zajednickoDobroPage.principi_1_opis: POEN cannot be exchanged for money and is not a property right. Records are written and re-registered, but they always stay in the Protocol — they belong to the common good.
zajednickoDobroPage.principi_2_opis: The system collects only the data it needs. First and last name, when entered, are kept separately from contribution records and are not shown to other users.
zajednickoDobroPage.principi_3_opis: The AGPL-3.0 and CC BY-SA 4.0 licences cannot be replaced with more restrictive ones — not even by a decision of the Upper Kolo.
