postaniPokrovitelj.opis: A sponsor is a legal entity, sole trader or registered agricultural holding that donates to the Foundation. Before the first application, you enter the sponsor in the register once; you manage the entry, and the contribution for the applications you submit is recorded in your record.
postaniPokrovitelj.verifikacija_potrebna: Sponsorship with goods and services requires you to be in the Kolo
postaniPokrovitelj.verifikacija_opis: Any adult user can enter a sponsor and give a monetary sponsorship. Once the Foundation confirms receipt of the monetary sponsorship, you can choose “I'd like someone to call me”, and a Kolo member will call you. For sponsorship with goods and services, someone needs to confirm you or introduce you into the Kolo.
postaniPokrovitelj.verifikacija_link: How do I enter the Kolo →
postaniPokrovitelj.nivoi_napomena: Sponsorship follows the same table as a donation by a natural person. The tier is calculated from the total of the company's donations, separately from your personal donations, and the coefficient of the newly reached tier applies to the entire new donation. The table continues without limit. The minimum application is RSD 10,000.
postaniPokrovitelj.forma_opis: The platform generates a donation agreement from the entry data; you sign the agreement in the Agreements tab. Once the Foundation confirms receipt of the payment, the contribution is recorded in your record.
postaniPokrovitelj.forma_naziv_label: Name of legal entity or entrepreneur
postaniPokrovitelj.potpis_potvrda: Sign the donation agreement on behalf of the legal entity or entrepreneur?
postaniPokrovitelj.forma_minimum: The minimum sponsorship amount is {iznos} RSD.
postaniPokrovitelj.forma_minimum_napomena: The minimum sponsorship amount is {iznos} RSD. Sponsorship is a donation of money.
postaniPokrovitelj.forma_zastupnik_napomena: The Foundation compared the name, registration number and representative with the register when approving the entry. The name and surname from the entry are entered next to your account in the identity register (Article 31a of the Rulebook on the KOLO System) upon confirmation of receipt. Other members do not see that name and it is not published in the ranking list.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_opis: The sponsor undertakes to hand over goods, or provide services, free of charge to the persons who take a voucher. The Foundation does not receive or possess the goods: the voucher holder receives them directly from the sponsor.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_opis_label: Exact description of the good or service
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_opis_primer: e.g. men's haircut; or white bread, 500 g
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_iskljuceno: A voucher cannot be for tobacco and e-cigarettes, spirits, medicines, money, or vouchers and cards that can be exchanged for money, nor for anything that is also prohibited on the Marketplace (Rulebook on Sponsorship and Donations, art. 13f).
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_cena_label: Unit price you apply in trade (RSD)
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_vrednost: Agreement value: {vrednost} RSD. The value of each agreement is from {min} to {max} RSD.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_cenovnik_label: Photograph of the price list showing the price (one or more)
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_dokaz_napomena: The Foundation checks that a photograph of the price list is attached; it does not assess, compare or set the price. Only the Foundation's administrator team sees the photograph. Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, at most 2 MB per photograph.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_izjava_propisi: I declare that the sponsor complies with the regulations that apply to trade in this good or to the provision of this service.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_kvota_napomena: The same sponsor may conclude a further agreement once at least half of the vouchers of the previous agreement have been used. A sponsor whose agreement was terminated for non-performance is entered on the ban list and cannot conclude a new agreement until the Foundation removes them from the list.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_porezi_napomena: Sponsorship in goods and services is a donation without consideration. The Foundation does not issue invoices and does not give tax advice. No fiscal receipt or electronic invoice is issued for handing over goods or providing services under a voucher; the sponsor documents it with a handover confirmation downloaded from the platform. A sponsor who is registered for VAT must account for VAT on goods handed over and services provided without consideration, in accordance with the regulations.
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_nosilac_label: Name and surname of the farm holder
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_odnos_ovlasceno_lice: Person authorised by the competent body
postaniPokrovitelj.dobra_rok_napomena: A voucher is valid for one year from issue.
postaniPokrovitelj.logotip_greska_fajl: The logo can be JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 1 MB.
postaniPokrovitelj.logotip_greska_slanja: The logo was not attached. Try again.
postaniPokrovitelj.objasnjenje_novac: A legal entity or sole trader pays the donation into the Foundation's account, under an agreement the platform generates from the entry. The smallest application is 10,000 RSD.
postaniPokrovitelj.objasnjenje_dobra: The sponsor undertakes to hand over goods or provide services free of charge to participants who take a voucher. The Foundation neither receives nor owns the goods.
postaniPokrovitelj.moje_firme_prazno: You have not entered any sponsor yet.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_samo_punoletni: A sponsor is registered by an adult user.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_vrsta_firma_opis: Entered by the legal representative, sole trader, owner, one of the owners or the beneficial owner.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_vrsta_gazdinstvo_opis: Entered exclusively by the farm holder.
postaniPokrovitelj.obrisani_opis: A deleted sponsor is not on the map and has no voucher offer, while contributions made before deletion remain on the ranking list with the name and logo. At your request it is also removed from the ranking list.
postaniPokrovitelj.ranglista_ukloni_potvrda: Also remove “{naziv}” from the sponsor ranking list? This cannot be undone.

postaniPokrovitelj.potvrdjujem_opis: The sponsor has designated you to check and confirm vouchers on its behalf. You have no other powers regarding its agreements.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_uvod: A sponsor is entered once. The Foundation compares the name, registration number and representative with the register and approves the entry; you submit sponsorship applications from the approved entry.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_predlog_gazdinstva: You are the holder of the farm “{naziv}”. You can take the data from the farm.
postaniPokrovitelj.logotip_napomena_upis: Optional: a sponsor without a logo is shown by name only. JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 1 MB. The logo is kept in the sponsor register and is shown next to the name on the ranking list, on the map, on vouchers and with the voucher offer.
postaniPokrovitelj.logotip_napomena_izmena: A new logo goes for review by the Foundation; until the decision, the current one remains.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_mapa_opis: The sponsor is shown on the map with its name, logo, place and address, together with its voucher offer. Nothing else is shown.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_tacka_napomena: Check the point found from the address or click on the map to place it.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_izjava_adresa: The sponsor consents to the address being displayed on the map. The display lasts as long as the sponsor is entered and ends when the entry is deleted.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_izjava_ovlascenja: I declare that I am authorised to conclude donation agreements on behalf of the sponsor.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_izjava_ovlascenja_organ: I declare that the competent body of the sponsor (assembly, management board or another body under the statute) has authorised me to make the entry and to conclude donation contracts on behalf of the sponsor.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_potvrda_evidentiranja: I understand that the contribution for the applications I submit is recorded in my record, that the Foundation does not distribute it among the sponsor's owners, and that, if I am not the sole owner, I must inform the owners about the agreements and the recorded contribution.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_potvrda_evidentiranja_organi: I am aware that the contribution under the applications I submit is recorded in my record, that the Foundation does not distribute it to the members or bodies of the sponsor, and that I am obliged to inform the competent bodies and members of the sponsor about the contracts and the recorded contribution.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_napomena_firma: The Foundation compares the name, registration number and representative with the business register. Your first and last name are entered in the identity record when receipt of the donation is confirmed; other users do not see it.
postaniPokrovitelj.upis_napomena_gazdinstvo: A farm is entered exclusively by its holder. The Foundation may request confirmation of the farm's entry in the register when there is a reason to do so. The holder's name is entered in the identity register upon confirmation of receipt of the donation.
postaniPokrovitelj.razlog_nije_odobren: An application is submitted from an approved entry — wait for the Foundation to approve the entry.
postaniPokrovitelj.razlog_zabrana: The sponsor is on the ban list after termination of an agreement and cannot conclude a new agreement on sponsorship in goods and services until the Foundation removes it from the list.
postaniPokrovitelj.razlog_nepotpun: The entry lacks some of the data needed for the agreement — complete them in the Details tab.
postaniPokrovitelj.podaci_izmena_na_proveri: The change of name, registration number or logo is under review by the Foundation. Until the decision, the previously approved details apply.
postaniPokrovitelj.podaci_napomena: Contact details, registered office and display on the map change immediately. The name, registration number and logo go for a new review by the Foundation. The tax ID (PIB) and BPG cannot be changed.
postaniPokrovitelj.brisanje_opis: Deletion is possible when the sponsor has no agreement on sponsorship in goods and services with unused vouchers. The display on the map and the voucher offer end; the agreements and the sponsor register are kept, and contributions made before deletion remain on the ranking list.
postaniPokrovitelj.brisanje_rang_lista: Also remove the sponsor from the ranking list
postaniPokrovitelj.brisanje_potvrda: Delete the sponsor entry? The display on the map and the voucher offer end, while contributions remain on the ranking list.
postaniPokrovitelj.brisanje_potvrda_rang: Delete the sponsor entry and remove it from the ranking list? This cannot be undone.
postaniPokrovitelj.sta_dobija_tekst: POEN is recorded for the person who submits the application, using the same table as for donations. The sponsor's name, and logo if it has one, is shown on the map and on the sponsor ranking list, and for sponsorship with goods and services also on the vouchers. This is a record of contribution, not advertising: the sponsor gains neither promotion nor an advantage in procurement.

dobrodosli.ekran1_p1: KOLO is a system in which people from the same area exchange work, goods and knowledge without money, and every contribution stays on record. What you give the community is entered for you in POEN. POEN is not money: it can't be bought and isn't exchanged for dinars.
dobrodosli.ekran1_p2: POEN exists so that an exchange need not be simultaneous or mutual. You can help a neighbour today and find what you need from a third person a month later.
dobrodosli.ekran2_p1: Post what you really have or can do: a lift to town, childminding, help in the garden, lessons, bicycle repair, surplus from your garden. You don't need a confirmation for that.
dobrodosli.ekran2_p2: For the first listing in which you offer something, {oglas} POEN is recorded for you once the Foundation approves it.
dobrodosli.ekran2_p3: Do you produce food? Register a farm too: once the Foundation approves it, it gets a point on the map, and your listings on its behalf get the DOMAĆE label.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p1: You are brought into the Kolo by someone who knows you personally. That is the only check; no documents are required.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p2: In the Kolo, contact from listings, conversation with anyone, programmes, procurement and vouchers open up for you. You and the person who introduced you each get {potvrda} POEN recorded once you make your first contribution.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p3: Do you know someone who is already in the Kolo? Open Confirmations, press “Show code” and show it to them.
dobrodosli.ekran3_p4: Don't know anyone? Choose “I'd like someone to call me”: a Kolo member will call you and, after the conversation, can bring you in.
dobrodosli.ekran4_p1: While you wait, fill in your profile: a picture, your place and a few words about yourself. For each field you choose who sees it, and your name and phone are optional.
dobrodosli.ekran4_p2: Everything is in the menu. Home has the news and the Chat room, “POEN” has your entry, and “Help” has this guide, frequently asked questions and bug reports.
dobrodosli.dete1_p1: This space is just for children: you exchange things, help and knowledge. Adults can't see it without your parent's permission.
dobrodosli.dete1_p2: POEN is entered for you for friendships and for what you give another child. POEN is not money and can't be bought.
dobrodosli.dete1_p3: For your account to work, mum or dad needs to take it over. We've sent them a message; if they didn't get it, read them the six-digit number on your screen.
dobrodosli.dete1_p4: While you wait, fill in your profile and collect friends. Once your parent takes over the account, you can write to friends and choose your school. Listings and POEN open up for you when your parent joins the Kolo and someone who knows them personally confirms that you are their child.
dobrodosli.dete2_p1: Create a listing for what you have or know how to do. Comics you have finished, a toy you no longer need, help with maths homework, drawing, walking a dog.
dobrodosli.dete2_p2: A listing needs a title, a description, a picture, a category and a place. You can post it once you become a Kolo child, and other children see it.
dobrodosli.dete2_p3: When someone wants what you offer, they will contact you and transfer POEN to you. You receive POEN from friendships and from exchanges with other children.
dobrodosli.dete3_p1: Every friendship brings {prijateljstvo} POEN to you and {prijateljstvo} to them. There is no limit on the number of friends.
dobrodosli.dete3_p2: A friendship is made in person only. Open Friends, press “Show code” and let your friend scan it with their phone. The code lasts five minutes, so you have to stand next to each other.
dobrodosli.dete3_p3: You both get POEN once you are both Kolo children; until then it says the POEN is waiting. You can be friends with your brother or sister, but without POEN.
dobrodosli.dete3_p4: In the Chatroom you see messages from your friends. What you write is seen only by those you are friends with.
dobrodosli.dete4_naslov: Profile, POEN and what to do with it
dobrodosli.dete4_p1: Fill in your profile and choose your school. Once you become a Kolo child, you can see how many Kolo children your school has and where you are on the list.
dobrodosli.dete4_p2: You see your POEN under “POEN”. It shows how much you have and where it came from. Once you become a Kolo child, your parent can re-register their POEN to you, and you can re-register yours to them.
dobrodosli.dete4_p3: You spend POEN by agreeing with another child and re-registering it to them for something you need. You give POEN, they give the thing or the help.

notifikacije.roditeljstvo_prijava_nema_osnova_naslov: The link with the child's account works again

notifikacije.roditeljstvo_prijava_odluka_podnosilac_n: The Foundation has decided on your report
notifikacije.roditeljstvo_prijava_odluka_podnosilac_t: The Foundation has decided on your report that a person is not the child's parent. You can file a complaint against the decision.
notifikacije.roditeljstvo_upisano_izjava_naslov: You have been entered as a parent
notifikacije.roditeljstvo_upisano_izjava_tekst: The account {pseudonim} has been converted into a child's account and you have been entered as its parent. Give the statement on the child's existence on the child's profile.
notifikacije.prijateljstvo_ne_kola_tekst: {dete} has made friends with {pseudonim}, whose account is not yet a Kolo child.

notifikacije.punoletstvo_potvrda_tekst: {iznos} POEN from {broj} friendships has been written off. Your parent has confirmed you, so you are now a Kolo member.
notifikacije.punoletstvo_uvodjenje_naslov: The account has become an adult account
notifikacije.punoletstvo_uvodjenje_tekst: {iznos} POEN from {broj} friendships has been written off. Your parent has introduced you into the Kolo, so you are now a member without confirmation. A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you — show them your code.
notifikacije.punoletstvo_korisnik_naslov: The account has become an adult account
notifikacije.punoletstvo_korisnik_tekst: {iznos} POEN from {broj} friendships has been written off. Neither parent is in the Kolo, so you are now a user. A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you — show them your code.
notifikacije.potvrda_poen_potvrdjivac: “{pseudonim}”, whose reality you confirmed, has made their first contribution, so {iznos} POEN has been entered for you for that confirmation.
notifikacije.potvrda_poen_potvrdjeni: For the confirmation given to you by “{pseudonim}”, {iznos} POEN has been entered for you.
notifikacije.potvrda_poen_ceka_potvrdjivac: You confirmed the reality of user “{pseudonim}”. {iznos} POEN will be entered for you when they make their first contribution — post an offer approved by the Foundation, donate, submit sponsorship on behalf of a company or farm, or complete a community task.
notifikacije.potvrda_poen_ceka_potvrdjeni: “{pseudonim}” has confirmed your reality. {iznos} POEN will be entered for you when you make your first contribution — post an offer approved by the Foundation, donate, submit sponsorship on behalf of a company or farm, or complete a community task.
notifikacije.potvrda_uskladjena: The rule has changed: POEN under a confirmation is recorded once the confirmed member makes their first contribution. {iznos} POEN has therefore been returned from your record and is now held as recorded. It will be entered as soon as the condition is met.
notifikacije.potvrda_uskladjena_minus: The rule has changed: POEN under a confirmation is recorded once the confirmed member makes their first contribution. {iznos} POEN has therefore been returned from your record, and your record is now {minus} POEN in the negative. This is not a debt and is not collected — POEN that arrives fills it first, exchanging goods and services is not restricted for you, and re-registering POEN to someone else becomes possible once your record passes zero. The recorded contribution remains and will be entered as soon as the condition is met.
notifikacije.nadzor_poen_upisan: The confirmation you supervised has been unlocked by the confirmed member's first contribution, so {iznos} POEN has been recorded for you for the supervision performed.
notifikacije.nadzor_poen_ponisten: Review no longer brings POEN. That is why {iznos} POEN that had earlier been entered for you for completed reviews has been cancelled from your entry. The entry and the cancellation remain visible in your history. If you think the cancellation is wrong, you can file an objection from your profile.
notifikacije.zadruga_zadrugar_naslov: You have become a cooperative member
notifikacije.zadruga_zadrugar_tekst: Your account has been linked to the cooperative {zadruga}.

notifikacije.zadruga_zapis_primljen_tekst: The cooperative {zadruga} has re-registered {iznos} POEN to your record.
notifikacije.akti_izmenjeni_naslov: The KOLO system acts have been amended
notifikacije.akti_izmenjeni_tekst: A new version of the acts has been adopted ({verzija}). Please confirm your consent the next time you open the platform.

notifikacije.gazdinstvo_admin_pristupanje_tekst: Another member has joined the farm “{naziv}” and is awaiting review by the Foundation.

notifikacije.gazdinstvo_zabelezen_tekst: A farm contribution of {iznos} POEN has been noted for you. It is recorded once you have a published listing offering something and you are in the chain of confirmations — introduced into the Kolo or confirmed.

notifikacije.gazdinstvo_pristupanje_odbijeno_tekst: Your joining of the farm “{naziv}” was not approved: {razlog}
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_evidentiran_naslov: A farm contribution of {iznos} POEN has been recorded for you
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_evidentiran_tekst: The farm contribution — {iznos} POEN — has been recorded in your record (Rulebook art. 40c).
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_otpis_tekst: The approval of the farm “{naziv}” has been annulled because of a false declaration. {iznos} POEN has been written off from your record; the record may become negative (Rulebook art. 14 para. 3 item 6).
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_otpis_lazna_naslov: The farm has terminated: approval annulled
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_otpis_lazna_tekst: The approval of the farm “{naziv}” has been annulled because of a false declaration and the farm has terminated. Your noted farm contribution of {ponisten} POEN has been cancelled and {iznos} POEN has been written off; the record may become negative (Rulebook art. 14 para. 3 item 6). The contribution for the first listing remains. You can file a complaint against the decision.
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_otpis_brisanje_tekst: The farm “{naziv}” has been deleted from the platform and has thereby terminated. Your noted farm contribution of {ponisten} POEN has been cancelled and {iznos} POEN has been written off; the record may become negative (Rulebook art. 14 para. 3 item 6). The contribution for the first listing remains. You can acquire a farm contribution again in another farm. You can file a complaint against the termination.
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_otpis_bez_clanova_tekst: The farm “{naziv}” has terminated because no member took over the statement on the accuracy of the data, or because it no longer has any members. Your noted farm contribution of {ponisten} POEN has been cancelled and {iznos} POEN has been written off; the record may become negative (Rulebook art. 14 para. 3 item 6). The contribution for the first listing remains. You can acquire a farm contribution again in another farm. You can file a complaint against the termination.
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_upit_izjave_naslov: Take over the statement about the farm
notifikacije.gazdinstvo_upit_izjave_tekst: The member who was responsible for the statement on the accuracy of the data of the farm “{naziv}” no longer gives it. You can take it over within {dana} days. If no member takes over the statement, the farm terminates, and the members' noted farm contribution is cancelled and the recorded one written off.

notifikacije.pokroviteljstvo_dobra_odbijeno_naslov: Application for sponsorship in goods and services rejected
notifikacije.pokroviteljstvo_dobra_potpisano_tekst: The agreement has been signed and {broj} vouchers have been issued. {poen} POEN has been recorded.
notifikacije.vaucer_iskoriscen_tekst: The sponsor has confirmed that the voucher “{opis}” has been used. If you did not receive the good, or the service was not provided, you can lodge a complaint from your profile.
notifikacije.vaucer_zaposleni_dodat_tekst: You have been designated to confirm vouchers on behalf of the sponsor “{davalac}”. You check and confirm codes on the Sponsorship page.
notifikacije.vaucer_zaposleni_opozvan_tekst: Your authorisation to confirm vouchers on behalf of the sponsor “{davalac}” has ended.

notifikacije.vaucer_raskid_ispravka_tekst: The agreement for the voucher “{opis}” has been terminated because the sponsor did not perform the obligation. The voucher has ended, and {poen} POEN has been returned to your record.

notifikacije.pokroviteljstvo_dobra_raskid_zabrana_tek: Following a complaint, the Foundation has established that the obligation under the agreement “{opis}” was not performed, and the agreement has been terminated. The unused vouchers ({broj}) have ended and {poen} POEN has been written off. The sponsor has been entered on the ban list and cannot conclude a new agreement on sponsorship in goods and services until the Foundation removes it from the list. Reasoning: {obrazlozenje}
notifikacije.pokroviteljstvo_dobra_raskid_zabrana_min: The voucher agreement has been terminated: your record is in the minus

The unused vouchers ({broj}) have ended and {poen} POEN has been written off. Your record is now {stanje} POEN; POEN that arrives first fills the minus. notifikacije.zahtev_razgovor_tekst: “{pseudonim}” from {mesto} doesn't know any Kolo member and would like someone to call them. Maybe you know them.
notifikacije.spisak_nov_naslov: Someone would like someone to call them
notifikacije.spisak_nov_tekst: “{pseudonim}” doesn't know any Kolo member and would like someone to call them. Maybe you know them.
notifikacije.spisak_ponuda_donacija_naslov: Would you like someone to call you?
notifikacije.spisak_ponuda_donacija_tekst: The Foundation has established receipt of your donation. If you don't know any Kolo member, you can go on the call list: a Kolo member will call you and, after the conversation, can introduce you into the Kolo. You leave your phone number and consent; none of this is a condition for what you have already done.
notifikacije.spisak_ponuda_pokroviteljstvo_naslov: Would you like someone to call you?
notifikacije.spisak_ponuda_pokroviteljstvo_tekst: The Foundation has established receipt of the sponsorship under your application. If you don't know any Kolo member, you can go on the call list: a Kolo member will call you and, after the conversation, can introduce you into the Kolo. You leave your phone number and consent; none of this is a condition for what you have already done.
notifikacije.spisak_ponuda_gazdinstvo_rpg_naslov: Would you like someone to call you?
notifikacije.spisak_ponuda_gazdinstvo_rpg_tekst: You have registered a farm as its holder. If you don't know any Kolo member, you can go on the call list: a Kolo member will call you and, after the conversation, can bring you into the Kolo. The same conversation also counts for the farm's approval. You leave a phone number and your consent; none of this is a condition for what you have already done.
notifikacije.spisak_nov_potvrda_naslov: A member without confirmation is asking for a conversation
notifikacije.spisak_nov_potvrda_tekst: “{pseudonim}” is a member without confirmation and is asking for a conversation with a Kolo keeper for confirmation.
notifikacije.spisak_povezanih_tekst: You are now a Kolo member. On the Confirmations page you have a list of connections ({broj}): those you brought into the Kolo and the person who brought you in, if they are not yet confirmed. Confirm only those you know personally.
notifikacije.potvrda_sa_spiska_povezanih_naslov: You have become a Kolo member
notifikacije.potvrda_sa_spiska_povezanih_tekst: “{verifikator}” has confirmed you from their list of connections, so you have gone from member without confirmation to Kolo member. You now have a list of connections on the Confirmations page too: confirm from it only those you know personally. Belonging to the Kolo is not membership in the Foundation. If you don't know this person, report it on the Confirmations page.
notifikacije.visestruki_nalog_tekst: The Foundation has established that the account “{pseudonim}” is your second account. That account has ceased. You can file a complaint against the decision within 15 days. Reasoning: {obrazlozenje}
notifikacije.visestruki_nalog_otpis_tekst: The Foundation has established that the account “{pseudonim}” is your second account. That account has ceased, and the POEN re-registered from it to this account ({poen}) has been written off. You can file a complaint against the decision within 15 days. Reasoning: {obrazlozenje}
notifikacije.visestruki_nalog_otpis_minus_naslov: Multiple accounts established: your record is below zero
notifikacije.visestruki_nalog_otpis_minus_tekst: The Foundation has established that the account “{pseudonim}” is your second account. That account has ceased, and the POEN re-registered from it to this account ({poen}) has been written off. Your record is now {stanje} POEN; POEN that arrives first fills the minus. You can file a complaint against the decision within 15 days. Reasoning: {obrazlozenje}

deca.obavestenje_1: Only the child's pseudonym and date of birth are recorded. Nothing else.
deca.obavestenje_2: You give consent once. You do not approve each of the child's actions.
deca.obavestenje_3: You do not read conversations with other children; you see the list of friends and, for each of them, how many messages they exchanged and when the last one was. Conversations with adults you do read, and you open those with a switch that is off by default. You also see the profile, the exchanges and the listings, and you may remove any listing.
deca.obavestenje_4: You are answerable for everything the child publishes until you remove it.
deca.obavestenje_posledica: You give the statement that you have a child of the stated age under full responsibility, and it is kept. A false statement of parenthood is a serious breach of the rules and entails exclusion. Your child becomes a Kolo child once you are a Kolo member and a Kolo member who knows you personally confirms that you have that child.

deca.zahtevi_opis: A Kolo member is asking for confirmation that they have a child. Confirm only if you know them personally and know they have a child. Details of the child are not shown.
deca.zahtevi_stavka: {pseudonim} is asking for confirmation that they have a child.
deca.zahtevi_izjava: I know {pseudonim} personally and know that they have a child.
deca.zahtevi_napomena: The confirmation brings no POEN to you or to the parent. Whoever confirms a child who does not exist is answerable as for a false confirmation. The other parent of the same child does not give the confirmation.
deca.pseudonim_pravilo: Pseudonym: 3–30 characters, Latin letters (a–z), digits and _ . - only — no spaces and no č, ć, š, ž, đ. It may not start or end with a separator.
deca.razgovori_opis: Here you see what the child writes and who writes to them in conversations with adult users. You don't write in them — there is an adult on the other side — and you open and close those conversations with the switch above. You don't see conversations with other children.
deca.uvid_obavestenje: Your mum and dad do not read what you write to friends. They only see who you write with. If you write with an adult — they read that.
deca.poziv_predlog: The child {pseudonim} gave your address as the parent's address.
deca.preuzmi_opis: Enter the child's pseudonym and the six-digit code from their screen. The second parent uses the same path.
deca.polje_datum_preuzimanje_opis: If the account already has a date, leave this empty — the date cannot be changed once entered.
deca.pregled_opis: The content of conversations between children is not shown — only with whom and how much.
deca.polje_datum_raspon: Enter the child's date of birth — the child must be between 7 and 18 years old.
deca.lozinka_opis: If the child has not entered an e-mail address of their own, they cannot request a new password themselves. You set it here; you do not need to know the old one, and the child is notified that you changed it.
deca.lozinka_pravilo: At least {broj} characters. Write it down and tell your child.
deca.lozinka_uspeh: The password is set. Tell your child what it is.
deca.izjava_opis_bez_roka: By decision of the Foundation, the account has been converted into a child's account, and you have been entered as the parent. You give the statement under full responsibility; the text is kept and is not changed afterwards.
deca.izjava_dugme: I confirm and give the statement
deca.prekidac_zatvoren: Until the age of 15 the child exchanges and talks only with other children, and your consent does not change that. The switch becomes active when the child turns 15.
deca.lozinka_ima_adresu: The child has entered their own e-mail address, so from now on only they set the password. If access is genuinely lost, file an appeal from your profile — the Foundation decides.
deca.prepis_naslov: A re-registration is waiting for your approval
deca.prepis_opis: A larger re-registration from your child's record is not carried out until you approve it. Until then no POEN moves.
deca.prepis_rok: Expires in {dana} days; after that it is not carried out.
deca.postojanje_opis: Your child becomes a Kolo child once a Kolo member who knows you personally confirms that you have that child. The request is sent for each child separately and has no deadline. The confirmation brings no POEN.
deca.postojanje_dugme: Request confirmation that you have a child
deca.postojanje_trazeno: The request has been sent. Kolo members see it on the Confirmation page; it is confirmed by someone who knows you personally.
deca.postojanje_potvrdjeno: It has been confirmed that you have this child.
deca.postojanje_samo_clan_kola: Confirmation that you have a child is requested by a parent who is a Kolo member. Your powers as a parent do not depend on it.
deca.prijava_naslov: Report that this is not the parent
deca.prijava_opis: If another person entered as this child's parent is not their parent, report it to the Foundation. That person's link is immediately and temporarily stopped until the Foundation decides, unless the Foundation has already established for that link that the person is a parent; in that case the report is only considered. The person is not told who filed the report.
deca.prijava_polje: Briefly describe why you believe that person is not the parent (at least 10 characters).
deca.prijava_uspeh: The report has been sent. The link is stopped until the Foundation decides.
deca.prijava_dete_opis: These are the people entered as your parents. If one of them is not your parent, let the Foundation know. That person will not find out who told.
deca.prijava_dete_polje: Write briefly why this is not your parent (at least 10 letters).
deca.prijava_dete_uspeh: Sent. The Foundation will check. Until it decides, that person has no view of your account.
deca.prijava_trece_opis: If you know that one of the people entered as this child's parent is not their parent, report it to the Foundation. That person's link is immediately and temporarily stopped until the Foundation decides, unless the Foundation has already established for that link that the person is a parent; in that case the report is only considered. The person is not told who filed the report.
deca.zahtevi_fali_izjava: To confirm, tick the statement above the button.

registracijaDeteta.podnaslov: Pick a name and a password. Enter your mum's or dad's email — we will send them a message to approve your account.
registracijaDeteta.pseudonim_opis: Others see this name. No spaces and no accents. Numbers, a dash and a dot are fine.
registracijaDeteta.email_roditelja_opis: We send them one message to approve your account. Ask them today — without approval the account only works for 14 days.
registracijaDeteta.greska: The account was not created. Try again.
registracijaDeteta.uspeh_opis: We sent a message to {email}. While you wait, you can collect friends.

registracijaDeteta.kod_opis: If the message does not arrive, your mum or dad enter your name and this number.

registracijaDeteta.fali_email: Enter a valid parent's email address.

detePoziv.datum_opis: The date cannot be changed once entered. With it you give consent for the child's participation.
detePoziv.nije_moje_uvod: If this is not your child:
detePoziv.potvrda_brisanja: The account and all its data will be deleted. Continue?
detePoziv.istekao: The link has expired. Ask the child to read you the six-digit code from their screen and enter it in the “My children” section.
detePoziv.greska: The action was not carried out. Try again.
detePoziv.vec_preuzet_naslov: The account is already taken over
detePoziv.vec_preuzet_opis: The account {pseudonim} already has a parent. If you are the second parent, enter the pseudonym and the code in the “My children” section.
detePoziv.ishod_preuzet_opis: The child can now enter the Chat Room. POEN from friendships stays noted and is entered once the child becomes a Kolo child: once you become a Kolo member and a Kolo member confirms that the child exists.
detePoziv.ishod_odbijen_opis: We will not send you any more messages about this account. If nobody takes it over, it deletes itself.
detePoziv.ishod_obrisan_opis: The account and all data have been removed.
detePoziv.datum_raspon: Enter the child's date of birth — the child must be between 7 and 18 years old.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_naslov: If you don't have an account yet
detePoziv.nisam_clan_korak1: 1. Open your own account — it's free and it brings you back to this page.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_korak2: 2. Take over the child's account and enter the date of birth.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_korak3: 3. Ask a Kolo member who knows you personally to confirm you.
detePoziv.nisam_clan_poen: The child uses the platform as soon as you take over the account. Their POEN is entered once they become a Kolo child — once you become a Kolo member and a Kolo member confirms that the child exists. Nothing is lost; it all stays noted and is entered for them on that day.
detePoziv.dobijate: By taking over you gain insight into your child's friends and listings, the switch for conversations with adults, and the ability to set a new password for them. You do not see the content of conversations with other children.

potvrdiEmail.nisi_ti: If this was not you, close this page. Without confirmation the address is not saved anywhere.

nabavke.godisnji_pregled: Projects in {godina}: {iznos} RSD spent · procurements carried out: {broj}
nabavke.predlog_opis: Suggest what the next collective procurement should be.
nabavke.moja_POZVAN: You are invited — confirm your collection day.
nabavke.moja_POTVRDIO: Confirmed — you have a collection code.
nabavke.moja_ISTEKAO: The response period expired — the place went to the next in the order.
nabavke.moja_NIJE_PREUZEO: The share was not collected on the day entered. Your POEN has been released.
nabavke.registar_prazan: No one has proposed anything yet — be the first to propose.
nabavke.pravni_osnov: Rulebook on Projects and Collective Procurement, Art. 9–32.
nabavke.prijava_opis: Applications are open until {rok}. Applying does not touch your record — the obligation arises only when you confirm a collection day.
nabavke.prijave_zatvorene: Applications for this procurement are closed.
nabavke.cekas_mesto: You have applied — {mesto} in the order. An invitation arrives when your turn comes.
nabavke.cekas_red: You have applied. The order is established once applications close.
nabavke.pozvan: You are in — place {mesto}. {poen} POEN is annulled for your share on collection.
nabavke.pozvan_uputstvo: Choose the day you are coming for the goods. Only then is the POEN reserved.

nabavke.preuzeto: You have collected your share. {poen} POEN was annulled.

nabavke.paritet_napomena: The number of POEN per share is set by the decision that starts the procurement; it is not the price of the good and is not derived from it. nabavke.ponude_opis: All are published, including those not selected.
nabavke.preuzeli_napomena: The pseudonym and place in the queue are shown. The number of POEN in the entry is not published.

nabavke.dinarska_opis: Part of the report on the use of the Foundation's funds. It stands apart from the calculation because the number of POEN per share is not the price of the good and is not derived from it.

vauceri.uvod: Legal entities, sole traders and farms donate goods and services. A voucher is for a precisely specified good or service, is held under your pseudonym and cannot be transferred. You receive the good or service directly from the sponsor.
vauceri.izjava_nepovezan: I declare that I am not an owner, representative or applicant of this sponsor, nor related to them by kinship, marriage, cohabitation or a shared household.
vauceri.moji_prazno: You don't have any vouchers yet.
vauceri.moji_napomena: When taking it, show the QR code or read the code out to the sponsor, who confirms it in the app. The handover under a voucher is without consideration, so no receipt is issued.
vauceri.qr_uputstvo: The sponsor scans the code and confirms handover of the good or provision of the service.
vauceri.prigovor_link: The sponsor did not perform the obligation? Lodge a complaint
vauceri.davalac_link: Are you a sponsor, or do you confirm vouchers on a sponsor's behalf? Sponsorship
vauceri.davalac_uvod: Checking and confirming vouchers at handover. Agreements, signing and employees are on the sponsor page (Sponsorship).
vauceri.provera_opis: Enter or scan the code from the voucher. You see which good or service it is, whether the voucher is valid, until when, and the holder's pseudonym.
vauceri.skener_uputstvo: Point the camera at the voucher's QR code.
vauceri.stanje_iskoriscen: The voucher has already been used
vauceri.racun_napomena: Confirm only after the good has been handed over or the service provided, and issue the receipt prescribed for that transaction.
vauceri.realizacija_potvrda: Do you confirm that the good has been handed over or the service provided?
vauceri.potpisano: The agreement has been concluded and the vouchers have been issued. A copy of the agreement has been sent by e-mail.
vauceri.zaposleni_naslov: Who confirms vouchers on the sponsor's behalf
vauceri.zaposleni_opis: You can designate other participants, for example employees, to check and confirm this sponsor's vouchers through their own accounts. They don't see the agreements and have no other powers; the sponsor answers for their confirmations.
vauceri.dostupni_opis: Vouchers are available from issue. There is no queue and no application deadline: a voucher goes to whoever asks for it first.
vauceri.dostupni_prazno: There are no available vouchers at the moment.
vauceri.pristanak_prikaz: I consent to the record of the cancellation of POEN, with the description of the good or service and the sponsor's name, being shown with my pseudonym in the records available to other users. I am aware that such a display may reveal information about me, including health information when the voucher relates to such a service.
vauceri.uzet: The voucher is yours. The code is in the My vouchers section.
vauceri.uzimanje_napomena: When you take a voucher, the number of POEN for the voucher is immediately cancelled in your entry. If you don't use the voucher before it expires, the cancellation is not corrected. You can have at most two unused vouchers at a time. A voucher cannot be taken without the statement and consent.
vauceri.potpis_procitao: I have read the entire text of the agreement.
vauceri.potpis_ovlascen: I am authorised to conclude this agreement on behalf of the sponsor.
vauceri.potpis_saglasan: I agree that the agreement is concluded by confirmation on the platform and entry of the code from the e-mail, without a stamp or handwritten signature.
vauceri.kod_poslat: The code has been sent to your e-mail address. It is valid for 15 minutes.
vauceri.potpis_napomena: The code is valid for 15 minutes and can be entered incorrectly at most five times. Signing issues the vouchers, and a copy of the agreement is sent to the sponsor's contact e-mail and to you.

vauceri.potvrda_tekst: The goods were handed over, or the services provided, without consideration to persons designated by the KOLO Foundation, under the stated donation contract. The holders gave the sponsor no consideration whatsoever.
vauceri.potvrda_izdato: This confirmation was drawn up by the KOLO Platform on {datum}, based on the record of confirmed vouchers.

kontakt.fali_pristanak: To be on the list, tick the consent above the button.
kontakt.naslov: I'd like someone to call me
kontakt.uvod: If you don't know any Kolo member, enter your first and last name, place and phone number and leave a few words about yourself. A Kolo member will call you within seven days at the latest and, after the conversation, can bring you into the Kolo.
kontakt.uvod_osnov: For the list you need your first and last name, place, phone number and consent. The description and the time when you are available are optional, but they help the Kolo member who calls you.
kontakt.osnov_donacija: The Foundation has established receipt of your donation.
kontakt.osnov_pokroviteljstvo: The Foundation has established receipt of the sponsorship under your application.
kontakt.osnov_gazdinstvo_rpg: You have registered a farm as its holder.
kontakt.obavestenje: A Kolo member will call you. They will see your first and last name and phone number, and whether the same number or the same name is listed with another account. The Foundation records who opened your data.
kontakt.ne_potvrdjuje: Getting on the list does not confirm reality and is not a condition for anything you have already done.
kontakt.opis_placeholder: Briefly: what you do, what you offer or look for on the Marketplace
kontakt.dostupnost: When you are available for a conversation
kontakt.telefon_opis: No one sees the name and number until a Kolo member opens them, and then only they see them, while the call is open. The number stays on your profile after the call as well: you can change it, but not delete it, for as long as the account exists.
kontakt.pristanak: I agree to be on the call list. A Kolo member will call me and will see my first and last name and phone number, only while the call is open with them, and whether the same number or the same name is listed with another account, together with that account's place. Only Kolo members see the list. The Foundation records which Kolo member opened my details. My first and last name, place and number stay with my account for as long as it exists and are compared with other accounts. The details on the list are deleted when I am brought into the Kolo or confirmed, when I withdraw consent, or when my user status ends.
kontakt.dugme_posalji: I'd like someone to call me
kontakt.poslat: You are on the list. Kolo members have been notified.
kontakt.povucen: Consent has been withdrawn and the details on the list deleted. Your name, place and number stay with your account.
kontakt.status_poslat: You're on the call list. A Kolo member will call you within seven days at the latest. Once they bring you into the Kolo, the details on the list are deleted, while your name, place and number stay with your account.
kontakt.naslov_potvrda: I'd like someone to call me for confirmation
kontakt.uvod_potvrda: Enter your first and last name, place, phone number and the time you are available. A Kolo keeper will call you within seven days at the latest and, if after the conversation they can answer for you, will confirm you, and you become a Kolo member. The description is optional.
kontakt.obavestenje_potvrda: A Kolo keeper will call you. They will see your first and last name and phone number, and whether the same number or the same name is listed with another account. The Foundation records who opened your details.
kontakt.pristanak_potvrda: I agree to be on the call list for confirmation. A Kolo keeper will call me and will see my first and last name and phone number, only while the call is open with them, and whether the same number or the same name is listed with another account, together with that account's place. Only Kolo keepers see my request. The Foundation records which Kolo keeper opened my details. My first and last name, place and number stay with my account for as long as it exists and are compared with other accounts. The details on the list are deleted when I am confirmed or when I withdraw consent.
kontakt.poslat_potvrda: You're on the list. Kolo keepers have been notified.
kontakt.status_poslat_potvrda: You're on the call list for confirmation. A Kolo keeper will call you within seven days at the latest. Once they confirm you, the details on the list are deleted, while your name, place and number stay with your account.
kontakt.profil_napomena: Your first and last name, place and phone number are entered on your profile and stay with the account for as long as it exists. They are not shown on your public profile unless you turn that on yourself.
kontakt.ime_prezime_opis: Entered once. Later it can only be corrected through a “Data correction” complaint.
kontakt.ime_prezime_upisano: A name is already entered with your account. Corrections go through a “Data correction” complaint.

spisak.naslov: They'd like someone to call them
spisak.opis_clan_kola: People who don't yet know anyone in the Kolo; Kolo keepers also see members without confirmation who are asking for a conversation for confirmation. Open the name and number, call and get to know each other. After the conversation the decision is yours: you bring them in by entering the code they read out to you. The call is open only to you for {minuta} minutes, and you can have only one open at a time. The Foundation records who opened the name and number.
spisak.prazan: Nobody is currently waiting for someone to call them.
spisak.zakljucan: Another Kolo member has just opened the name and number.
spisak.ime_nije_upisano: No name entered — only the number is open.
spisak.posle_razgovora: After the conversation the decision is yours: you bring them into the Kolo by entering the code they read out to you in “Confirm” on this page.
spisak.nazove_naslov: I'd like someone to call me
spisak.nazove_opis: If you don't know any Kolo member, you can go on the call list. A Kolo member will call you within seven days at the latest and, after the conversation, can introduce you into the Kolo.
spisak.nazove_obavestenje: A Kolo member will call you. They will see your first and last name, if entered, and your phone number. The Foundation records who opened your data.
spisak.nazove_ne_potvrdjuje: Getting on the list does not by itself bring you into the Kolo; a Kolo member decides on that after the conversation.
spisak.nazove_na_spisku: You are on the call list. Number left: {telefon}
spisak.nazove_osnovi: The Foundation has established a ground on which you can go on the list with just your phone number:
spisak.nazove_dugme: I'd like someone to call me
spisak.nazove_povucen: Consent has been withdrawn and the number deleted.
spisak.nazove_potvrda_naslov: I'd like someone to call me for confirmation
spisak.nazove_potvrda_opis: If no Kolo member knows you personally, after 30 days in the Kolo you can ask for a phone conversation with a Kolo keeper. After the conversation they can confirm you, and you become a Kolo member.
spisak.nazove_potvrda_obavestenje: A Kolo keeper will call you, within seven days at the latest. They will see your first and last name, if entered, and your phone number. The Foundation records who opened your details. If you have entered ZRNO, you go to the top of the list and a Kolo keeper will call you within three days at the latest.
spisak.nazove_potvrda_dugme: I'd like someone to call me for confirmation
spisak.nazove_potvrda_uslov_dani: You can ask for a conversation for confirmation after 30 days in the Kolo, from {datum}.
spisak.nazove_potvrda_uslov_trideset_dana: You can ask for a conversation for confirmation after 30 days in the Kolo.
spisak.nazove_potvrda_uslov_prijava: A conversation for confirmation is not possible: an exchange report or a listing report against you has been upheld. A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you.
spisak.nazove_potvrda_uslov_nadzor: A conversation for confirmation is not possible: in a review case against you it was established that a confirmation was false. A Kolo member who knows you personally can confirm you.
spisak.osnov_potvrda: Asking for a conversation for confirmation
spisak.prioritet_zrno: Has entered ZRNO — call by {datum} at the latest
spisak.posle_razgovora_potvrda: After the conversation the decision is yours: you confirm them by entering the code they read out to you in “Confirm”, choosing “We got to know each other by phone”. This confirmation always goes to review.
spisak.gazdinstvo_razgovor: They have registered the farm “{naziv}”. The same conversation also counts for the farm's approval: record it when you finish.
spisak.gazdinstvo_sumnja: After the conversation there are grounds to suspect that the statement in the registration is not accurate.
spisak.gazdinstvo_zabelezi: Record the conversation for the farm
spisak.gazdinstvo_zabelezeno: The conversation for the farm has been recorded. The Foundation decides on approval.
spisak.plutajuca_naslov: Would you like to become a Kolo member?
spisak.plutajuca_opis: If no Kolo member knows you personally, a Kolo keeper can call you and confirm you after the conversation.
spisak.plutajuca_opis_zrno: You have entered ZRNO, but you only get a vote once you are confirmed. Leave your number: a Kolo keeper will call you within three days at the latest.
spisak.rok_prosao: The deadline for the call passed on {datum} — no one has opened the number yet
spisak.oznaka_isti_telefon: The same phone number is already listed with another account.
spisak.oznaka_isto_ime: The same first and last name is already listed with another account — place: {mesta}.
spisak.oznaka_objasnjenje: This is not a ban: household members share a number, and namesakes share a name. Ask during the conversation. If you suspect it is another account of the same person, do not bring them into the Kolo and let the Foundation know.
spisak.izjava_poverljivosti: I use the name and number only for this conversation, I do not note them down and I do not pass them on to anyone. I hold the conversation of my own free will; no one obliges me to do so. (The statement is given once, before the first opening.)

podrziPage.meta_desc: How to support KOLO: personally, with a donation to the Foundation, or as a company, association or registered farm, through sponsorship in money or in goods and services.
podrziPage.opis: From donations and cash sponsorship the Foundation covers the costs of the platform and of running the system. It does not distribute profit; everything it receives goes back into the system.
podrziPage.licno_tekst: You can donate to the Foundation. A donation is a separate act and buys nothing within the system.
podrziPage.firma_naslov: As a company, association or registered farm
podrziPage.firma_tekst: A company, an association and the holder of a registered agricultural holding can be sponsors, in money or in goods and services. POEN is recorded for the person who submits the application, using the same table as for donations, and a cash sponsor is listed on the ranking with its name and, if it has one, its logo. It gains neither promotion nor an advantage in procurement from this.
podrziPage.znanje_tekst: Help doesn't have to be money. We need knowledge of communication, law, accounting and programming, connections with cooperatives and associations, and a space for public talks. Do you run an association or a local community? Invite us to your place.
podrziPage.nalog_napomena: An account is required for a donation and for registering a sponsor. Everything is governed by the Rulebook on Sponsorship and Donations.
podrziPage.novac_opis: The Foundation does not distribute profit. It spends money from donations and sponsorship on running the platform and the system and on community projects and collective procurements, and records every cost with a category and description. You can see the individual entries on the System page once you log in.
